explanations.title: Activity 2: the postal label
explanations.body: Read this package label for the Chinese postal service (邮政特快专递). Using it as a guide, rewrite the sender and recipient addresses, fees, package weight and sending dates in English on the label that follows. The label gives: 寄件人 (sender) 马小文, 东城街五号, 青岛, 山东; 收件人 (recipient) 高大卫, 125 号三街, 蒙特雷市, 加州, 美国; 费用 (fees in yuan): 邮费 146.67, 保价费 25.00, 封装费 5.98, 其他费用 14.32, 费用合计 191.97; 包裹重量 (kg): 实际重量 2.50, 计费重量 2.30; 寄件人签名 马小文, 时间 2020.4.20 9:30. The English version (mine):

rows: Ma Xiaowen, No. 5 Dongcheng Street, Qingdao, Shandong
Gao Dawei, 125 Third Street, Monterey, California, USA
2.50 kg actual weight; 2.30 kg billed weight (as printed)
tables.title: The label in English

explanations.title: Activity 3: conjunctions
explanations.body: Complete the sentences with the conjunctions in the table: 除了…(以外), 还/也…; 连…都/也…; (不但)…而且…; 如果…就…; 只要…就…; 虽然…但是…. The book prints the sentences with blanks; the answers below are mine, with 如果 or 只要 where either fits.

examples.text: 除了语法课和阅读课，我们还有听力课和说话课。
examples.translation: chú le yǔ fǎ kè hé yuè dú kè wǒ men hái yǒu tīng lì kè hé shuō huà kè — Besides the grammar and reading classes, we also have listening and speaking classes.

examples.text: 只要努力，你就一定能学好中文。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǔ lì nǐ jiù yí dìng néng xué hǎo zhōng wén — As long as you work hard, you will certainly learn Chinese well.

examples.text: 他做的什么菜都辣，连饺子里都放了辣椒。
examples.translation: tā zuò de shén me cài dōu là lián jiǎo zi lǐ dōu fàng le là jiāo — Every dish he makes is spicy; even the dumplings have chili in them.

examples.text: 那家饭店菜做得好，而且服务也很不错。
examples.translation: nà jiā fàn diàn cài zuò de hǎo ér qiě fú wù yě hěn bú cuò — That restaurant’s food is well made, and its service is also very good.

examples.text: 如果没有什么问题，我们就下课吧。
examples.translation: rú guǒ méi yǒu shén me wèn tí wǒ men jiù xià kè ba — If there are no problems, let’s end class.

examples.text: 房租是贵了点儿，可是不但带家具，而且连水电费都包了。
examples.translation: fáng zū shì guì le diǎnr kě shì bú dàn dài jiā jù ér qiě lián shuǐ diàn fèi dōu bāo le — The rent is a bit expensive, but it not only comes with furniture, it even includes the water and electricity.

examples.text: 如果你买三件，我就给你打九折。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ mǎi sān jiàn wǒ jiù gěi nǐ dǎ jiǔ zhé — If you buy three pieces, I’ll give you 10% off.

examples.text: 网上开户很简单，只要在银行的网站上注册一下就可以了。
examples.translation: wǎng shàng kāi hù hěn jiǎn dān zhǐ yào zài yín háng de wǎng zhàn shàng zhù cè yí xià jiù kě yǐ le — Opening an account online is very simple; you only need to register on the bank’s website.

examples.text: 这件衣服虽然有点贵，但是质量很好。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn yī fú suī rán yǒu diǎn guì dàn shì zhì liàng hěn hǎo — Although this piece of clothing is a bit expensive, its quality is very good.

explanations.title: Activity 4: write sentences with the patterns
explanations.body: A. Write sentences with 除了…以外，还/也…, 连…都/也…, （不但）…而且…, 如果…就…, 只要…就…, 虽然…但是…. B. Read your sentences to a partner while they translate them orally. One set of examples (mine):

examples.text: 除了做作业，我还要预习新课。
examples.translation: chú le zuò zuò yè wǒ hái yào yù xí xīn kè — Besides doing homework, I also have to preview the new lesson.

examples.text: 连小贩都用手机收费。
examples.translation: lián xiǎo fàn dōu yòng shǒu jī shōu fèi — Even the vendors use their phones to collect fees.

examples.text: 这个公寓不但很大，而且很便宜。
examples.translation: zhè ge gōng yù bú dàn hěn dà ér qiě hěn pián yi — This apartment is not only big but also cheap.

examples.text: 如果你喜欢，我就买给你。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ xǐ huān wǒ jiù mǎi gěi nǐ — If you like it, I’ll buy it for you.

examples.text: 只要你注册，就可以用网上银行。
examples.translation: zhǐ yào nǐ zhù cè jiù kě yǐ yòng wǎng shàng yín háng — As long as you register, you can use online banking.

examples.text: 这双鞋虽然很好看，但是有点儿贵。
examples.translation: zhè shuāng xié suī rán hěn hǎo kàn dàn shì yǒu diǎnr guì — Although these shoes look good, they are a bit expensive.

explanations.title: Activity 5: 要, 想, 想要, 得, 不要, 需要
explanations.body: Complete the sentences with 要, 想, 想要, 得(děi), 不要 or 需要, then compare with a partner and explain any differences. The book leaves the blanks; my answers (other choices can work in a few of them):

examples.text: 我想去农贸市场看看。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng qù nóng mào shì chǎng kàn kàn — I’d like to go to the farmers’ market and have a look.

examples.text: 每天我都要去体育馆锻炼。
examples.translation: měi tiān wǒ dōu yào qù tǐ yù guǎn duàn liàn — Every day I have to go to the gym to work out.

examples.text: 除了做作业，我还需要预习新课。
examples.translation: chú le zuò zuò yè wǒ hái xū yào yù xí xīn kè — Besides homework, I also need to preview the new lesson.

examples.text: 你们想要点儿什么主食？
examples.translation: nǐ men xiǎng yào diǎnr shén me zhǔ shí — What staple food would you like?

examples.text: 我要一瓶啤酒。
examples.translation: wǒ yào yì píng pí jiǔ — I’d like a bottle of beer.

examples.text: 菜里不要放味精。
examples.translation: cài lǐ bú yào fàng wèi jīng — Don’t put MSG in the dishes.

examples.text: 我想开一个活期账户。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng kāi yí gè huó qī zhàng hù — I’d like to open a current account.

examples.text: 租房以前得先付一个月的押金。
examples.translation: zū fáng yǐ qián děi xiān fù yí gè yuè de yā jīn — Before renting you have to pay a month’s deposit first.

examples.text: 我想要租一套有两个卧室的公寓。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng yào zū yí tào yǒu liǎng gè wò shì de gōng yù — I’d like to rent an apartment with two bedrooms.

examples.text: 今天作业太多了，我得晚点儿睡觉。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zuò yè tài duō le wǒ děi wǎn diǎnr shuì jiào — There is too much homework today; I have to go to bed a bit later.

explanations.title: Activity 6: 什么, 什么的, 多, 什么时候, 怎么, 怎么样
explanations.body: Complete the sentences with 什么, 什么的, 多, 什么时候, 怎么 or 怎么样 and compare with a partner. My answers:

examples.text: 你觉得这套西装怎么样？
examples.translation: nǐ jué de zhè tào xī zhuāng zěn me yàng — What do you think of this suit?

examples.text: 那套公寓有多大？
examples.translation: nà tào gōng yù yǒu duō dà — How big is that apartment?

examples.text: 你就一个人，怎么租这么大的房子？
examples.translation: nǐ jiù yí gè rén zěn me zū zhè me dà de fáng zi — You are just one person; why rent such a big house?

examples.text: 你们什么时候考试？
examples.translation: nǐ men shén me shí hòu kǎo shì — When do you have the test?

examples.text: 我们就租这套公寓，怎么样？
examples.translation: wǒ men jiù zū zhè tào gōng yù zěn me yàng — Let’s just rent this apartment, how about it?

examples.text: 我想去农贸市场买点儿水果，像苹果，香蕉什么的。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng qù nóng mào shì chǎng mǎi diǎnr shuǐ guǒ xiàng píng guǒ xiāng jiāo shén me de — I’d like to go to the farmers’ market to buy some fruit, like apples, bananas and so on.

examples.text: 妈妈做的什么菜我都喜欢。
examples.translation: mā mā zuò de shén me cài wǒ dōu xǐ huān — I like any dish Mom makes.

examples.text: 我不知道怎么在网上办手续。
examples.translation: wǒ bù zhī dào zěn me zài wǎng shàng bàn shǒu xù — I don’t know how to do the procedures online.

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8: (一)点儿, 一下, 有点儿, and the email
explanations.body: Activity 7. Translate the sentences below using (一)点儿, 一下 or 有点儿: 1. What would you like to drink? 2. May I see your flight ticket? 3. I’ve been a bit busy recently. 4. Excuse me, this shirt is a little small. Can I have a larger one? 5. Can this pair of shoes be a little cheaper? 6. It’s a bit expensive, but it’s the latest model and the quality is good. My translations:

examples.text: 你想喝点儿什么？
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng hē diǎnr shén me — What would you like to drink?

examples.text: 我可以看一下你的机票吗？
examples.translation: wǒ kě yǐ kàn yí xià nǐ de jī piào ma — May I see your flight ticket?

examples.text: 我最近有点儿忙。
examples.translation: wǒ zuì jìn yǒu diǎnr máng — I’ve been a bit busy recently.

examples.text: 请问，这件衬衫有点儿小，能给我一件大一点儿的吗？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn zhè jiàn chèn shān yǒu diǎnr xiǎo néng gěi wǒ yí jiàn dà yì diǎnr de ma — Excuse me, this shirt is a little small. Can I have a larger one?

examples.text: 这双鞋能便宜一点儿吗？
examples.translation: zhè shuāng xié néng pián yi yì diǎnr ma — Can this pair of shoes be a little cheaper?

examples.text: 有点儿贵，不过是最新的样式，质量也很好。
examples.translation: yǒu diǎnr guì bú guò shì zuì xīn de yàng shì zhì liàng yě hěn hǎo — It’s a bit expensive, but it’s the latest style and the quality is good.

explanations.title: Activity 8: email with 已经, 还有, 才, 就, 离, 再, 都
explanations.body: Complete the email with 已经, 还有, 才, 就, 离, 再 or 都; some words may be used more than once. The book’s text has a blank before 一个月 and one after 我; I read it as 还有 … 就. The completed email (my answers):

examples.text: 小文：我到台湾已经好几个月了。这里的天气跟我们老家很不一样，到这里很长时间以后我才适应了。我住的地方离学校很近，走路十几分钟就到了。我每天早上五点起床，我先锻炼身体，然后再去上课。这里的学习很紧张，我们每天都有七节课，下午五点才下课。因为今天有一个考试，我昨晚十二点才睡觉。我每天都去一家小饭店吃晚饭，那家饭店就在我的公寓楼旁边，非常方便。还有一个月我就回去了，我买了一个礼物送给你。我想你一定会喜欢的。祝好！大卫
examples.translation: xiǎo wén wǒ dào tái wān yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ gè yuè le zhè lǐ de tiān qì gēn wǒ men lǎo jiā hěn bù yí yàng dào zhè lǐ hěn cháng shí jiān yǐ hòu wǒ cái shì yìng le wǒ zhù de dì fāng lí xué xiào hěn jìn zǒu lù shí jǐ fēn zhōng jiù dào le wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn qǐ chuáng wǒ xiān duàn liàn shēn tǐ rán hòu zài qù shàng kè zhè lǐ de xué xí hěn jǐn zhāng wǒ men měi tiān dōu yǒu qī jié kè xià wǔ wǔ diǎn cái xià kè yīn wèi jīn tiān yǒu yí gè kǎo shì wǒ zuó wǎn shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào wǒ měi tiān dōu qù yì jiā xiǎo fàn diàn chī wǎn fàn nà jiā fàn diàn jiù zài wǒ de gōng yù lóu páng biān fēi cháng fāng biàn hái yǒu yí gè yuè wǒ jiù huí qù le wǒ mǎi le yí gè lǐ wù sòng gěi nǐ wǒ xiǎng nǐ yí dìng huì xǐ huān de zhù hǎo dà wèi — Xiaowen: I have already been in Taiwan for several months. The weather here is very different from our hometown, and only after a long time here did I adapt. Where I live is very close to school; it takes just over ten minutes to walk there. Every morning I get up at five, first I exercise, and then I go to class. Studying here is intense; we have seven classes every day and don’t finish until five in the afternoon. Because there is a test today, I didn’t go to sleep until twelve last night. Every day I go to a small restaurant for dinner; that restaurant is right next to my apartment building, which is very convenient. In one more month I will be going back, and I bought a gift to give you. I think you will surely like it. All the best! David

explanations.title: Activities 9 to 11: 把, the voicemail and the degree complement 得
explanations.body: Activity 9. Translate the sentences using 把 and compare with a partner: 1. Put the bowl on the table. 2. Where did you put my cellphone? 3. We all finished our homework. 4. Please don’t bring beverages into the library. 5. You need to link your bank account to your e-wallet. My translations:

examples.text: 把碗放在桌子上。
examples.translation: bǎ wǎn fàng zài zhuō zi shàng — Put the bowl on the table.

examples.text: 你把我的手机放在哪儿了？
examples.translation: nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī fàng zài nǎr le — Where did you put my cellphone?

examples.text: 我们都把作业做完了。
examples.translation: wǒ men dōu bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le — We all finished our homework.

examples.text: 请不要把饮料带进图书馆。
examples.translation: qǐng bú yào bǎ yǐn liào dài jìn tú shū guǎn — Please don’t bring beverages into the library.

examples.text: 你得把你的银行账户和电子钱包连在一起。
examples.translation: nǐ děi bǎ nǐ de yín háng zhàng hù hé diàn zi qián bāo lián zài yì qǐ — You need to link your bank account to your e-wallet.

explanations.title: Activities 10 and 11
explanations.body: Activity 10 (Listening and Speaking). Listen to the voicemail and take notes on what Xiaoming’s mother asked him to do; the new word is 报纸 (bàozhǐ: newspaper). Then discuss in Chinese what she told him to do. (Audio, not included.) Activity 11. Pair up and make sentences connecting the terms on the left (说中文, 写汉字, 做菜, 做作业, 吃饭, 考试, 游泳) with the adjectives on the right (a. 怎么样, b. 好, c. 快, d. 多, e. 不错, f. 不好, g. 不怎么样) using the degree complement 得, taking turns until you have each said seven sentences. The book’s two examples and my sentences:

examples.text: 他说中文说得很快。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn kuài — He speaks Chinese very fast. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 他说中文说得不怎么样。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de bù zěn me yàng — He doesn’t speak Chinese all that well. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 她写汉字写得不错。
examples.translation: tā xiě hàn zì xiě de bú cuò — She writes characters quite well.

examples.text: 我做菜做得不好。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò cài zuò de bù hǎo — I don’t cook well.

examples.text: 我做作业做得很快。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò zuò yè zuò de hěn kuài — I do my homework very fast.

examples.text: 他吃饭吃得很多。
examples.translation: tā chī fàn chī de hěn duō — He eats a lot.

examples.text: 我们考试考得怎么样？
examples.translation: wǒ men kǎo shì kǎo de zěn me yàng — How did we do on the test?

examples.text: 我游泳游得不怎么样。
examples.translation: wǒ yóu yǒng yóu de bù zěn me yàng — I don’t swim all that well.

lessons.title: 296. Lesson 12 (Unit 2 review): skill integration review
lessons.subtitle: 国防语言学院的生活 · 我家的房子 · 外国人也能在中国“扫码”

explanations.title: Activities 1 to 4 (listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1. A. Listen to the dialog and mark five statements true or false (statements below; audio, so no key is given). B. Listen again and fill in a table with the drinks, dishes, soups and staples that David and Mark ordered. C. Read the script and perform the dialog. Activity 2. A. Listen to a dialog about going somewhere to buy a shirt, and answer: 1. Where do the speakers want to go? 2. Why? 3. What does the first speaker say about the second speaker? 4. What does the first speaker plan to do? 5. What does the second speaker suggest? B. Listen again; complete Table 1 (凯丽的衬衫) while a partner completes Table 2 (网上购物) with four EEIs each, then exchange information to fill in Table 3 (Linda’s purchases at the farmers’ market: items, total spent, payment method). D. In groups of three, discuss your own shopping habits (online vs. in-person shopping). Activity 3. A. Listen to the phone call about renting: how was the conversation conducted, and which of three apartments (两室一厅, 三室两厅二卫, 四室两厅二卫) would interest the applicant? B. What does the manager recommend, what is the total of the first payment and what does it include, what are three details about the facilities and surroundings, and when can the applicant sign the contract? D. Tell your partner about a place you once rented. Activity 4. A. Where does the bank conversation take place and what does the customer want to do? B. Fill in a table: the three steps for opening an account, the account(s) opened and why, the currency exchange amount and rate, and the online banking services. (All audio, not included.) The Activity 1 statements:

examples.text: 大卫和他的三个朋友一起去吃饭。
examples.translation: dà wèi hé tā de sān gè péng yǒu yì qǐ qù chī fàn — David goes to eat with his three friends.

examples.text: 他们已经在网上订了桌子。
examples.translation: tā men yǐ jīng zài wǎng shàng dìng le zhuō zi — They already booked a table online.

examples.text: 这家餐馆的特色菜是烤鸭。
examples.translation: zhè jiā cān guǎn de tè sè cài shì kǎo yā — This restaurant’s specialty is roast duck.

examples.text: 大卫喜欢吃清淡的菜。
examples.translation: dà wèi xǐ huān chī qīng dàn de cài — David likes light dishes.

examples.text: 大卫的朋友马克不喜欢咸的菜。
examples.translation: dà wèi de péng yǒu mǎ kè bù xǐ huān xián de cài — David’s friend Mark doesn’t like salty dishes.

explanations.title: Activity 5: an email from a DLI student
explanations.body: A. Scan the email message from a DLI student (the book prints the subject 国防语言学院的生活) and answer: 1. What is the email about? 2. How has the student changed? 3. What are the two major topics? (Mine: 1. His life at DLI. 2. At first he wasn’t used to it; now he has completely adapted. 3. His weekday schedule and his weekends.) B. Reread the second paragraph while a partner rereads the third, then write a Chinese summary of your paragraph and read it to your partner. C. Read your summary to the class.

examples.text: 大哥：你好！你上次问我我在国防语言学院的生活怎么样？怎么说呢？一开始我不太习惯，现在完全适应了。在国防语言学院学习，因为我们又是军人又是学生，所以非常忙。我们每天早上六点半集合，然后上六节课，早上七点四十五分上课，下午两点五十下课。每天我们有阅读课、听力课、语法课和说话课。中午我们有一个小时吃饭的时间。下午下课以后我们去操场锻炼身体，晚上还得做作业、预习生词和课文。有时候我们还要值班。所以，我常常十点以后才能睡觉。不过，我很喜欢这儿的周末，因为有时间可以做我想做的事情。星期六和星期天，我差不多九点半起床。早饭以后，我先去体育馆锻炼身体，然后和朋友去中国饭馆吃午饭、聊天。下午，有时我和同学去看电影、有时去海边散步、有时去购物买东西。星期天晚上我常常去图书馆做作业，因为星期一要上课。好了，今天就说到这儿吧。下个星期给你打电话。祝好！弟弟
examples.translation: dà gē nǐ hǎo nǐ shàng cì wèn wǒ wǒ zài guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn de shēng huó zěn me yàng zěn me shuō ne yì kāi shǐ wǒ bú tài xí guàn xiàn zài wán quán shì yìng le zài guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn xué xí yīn wèi wǒ men yòu shì jūn rén yòu shì xué shēng suǒ yǐ fēi cháng máng wǒ men měi tiān zǎo shàng liù diǎn bàn jí hé rán hòu shàng liù jié kè zǎo shàng qī diǎn sì shí wǔ fēn shàng kè xià wǔ liǎng diǎn wǔ shí xià kè měi tiān wǒ men yǒu yuè dú kè tīng lì kè yǔ fǎ kè hé shuō huà kè zhōng wǔ wǒ men yǒu yí gè xiǎo shí chī fàn de shí jiān xià wǔ xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù cāo chǎng duàn liàn shēn tǐ wǎn shàng hái děi zuò zuò yè yù xí shēng cí hé kè wén yǒu shí hòu wǒ men hái yào zhí bān suǒ yǐ wǒ cháng cháng shí diǎn yǐ hòu cái néng shuì jiào bú guò wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhèr de zhōu mò yīn wèi yǒu shí jiān kě yǐ zuò wǒ xiǎng zuò de shì qíng xīng qī liù hé xīng qī tiān wǒ chà bu duō jiǔ diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng zǎo fàn yǐ hòu wǒ xiān qù tǐ yù guǎn duàn liàn shēn tǐ rán hòu hé péng yǒu qù zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī wǔ fàn liáo tiān xià wǔ yǒu shí wǒ hé tóng xué qù kàn diàn yǐng yǒu shí qù hǎi biān sàn bù yǒu shí qù gòu wù mǎi dōng xī xīng qī tiān wǎn shàng wǒ cháng cháng qù tú shū guǎn zuò zuò yè yīn wèi xīng qī yī yào shàng kè hǎo le jīn tiān jiù shuō dào zhèr ba xià gè xīng qī gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà zhù hǎo dì di — Big brother: Hello! Last time you asked me how my life at the Defense Language Institute is. How shall I put it? At first I wasn’t quite used to it, and now I have completely adapted. Studying at DLI, because we are both military and students, we are very busy. Every day at 6:30 in the morning we fall in, then we have six classes, starting at 7:45 and ending at 2:50 in the afternoon. Every day we have reading, listening, grammar and speaking classes. At noon we have an hour to eat. After class in the afternoon we go to the drill field to exercise, and in the evening we still have to do homework and preview new words and texts. Sometimes we also have to stand duty. So I often can’t go to sleep until after ten. But I really like the weekends here, because there is time to do what I want. On Saturday and Sunday I get up at about 9:30. After breakfast I first go to the gym to exercise, then go with friends to a Chinese restaurant for lunch and chat. In the afternoon, sometimes my classmates and I go to a movie, sometimes to the seaside for a walk, and sometimes shopping. On Sunday evening I often go to the library to do homework, because there is class on Monday. All right, that’s all for today. I’ll call you next week. All the best! Little brother

explanations.title: Activity 6: the house passage
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and write an appropriate title in Chinese (mine: 我家的房子). B. In your notebook draw a picture of the place described and compare pictures with the class. C. Form groups of three; each student completes one vocabulary list (List 1—Furniture, List 2—Rooms, List 3—Layout) and reads it to the group. My lists are below the passage.

rows: 沙发、咖啡桌、饭桌、椅子、办公桌、书架、电脑、双人床、床头柜、躺椅、衣橱
客厅、厨房、饭厅、书房、卫生间、卧室、主卧室、阁楼、活动室、地下室、车库
三层楼；前边是小花园，后边是大院子；客厅的对面是厨房，厨房的旁边是饭厅；客厅的左边是书房；二楼有三个卧室；三楼是阁楼；还有地下室和车库
tables.title: Vocabulary lists

examples.text: 我家在华盛顿州的西雅图市。我们家的房子是一个三层楼的房子。房子的前边有一个小花园，里边种着很多漂亮的花。后边是个大院子，里面种着一些蔬菜和果树。我家的屋顶是深咖啡色的，外墙是浅黄色的，大门是红色的。进门后，你会看见一个大客厅，客厅里摆着一张长沙发，一个两人沙发和一张咖啡桌。客厅的后墙上有四个大窗户，所以客厅很明亮。客厅的对面是厨房，厨房的旁边是饭厅，饭厅里有一张饭桌和六把椅子。客厅的左边是书房，书房很小，只摆着一张办公桌，一个书架和一台电脑。书房的旁边是个卫生间。二楼有三个卧室，第一个房间是我弟弟的房间，旁边是一个卫生间，这个卫生间是我弟弟和妹妹共用的。卫生间的右边是我妹妹的房间。最里面是我爸爸妈妈住的主卧室，他们有自己的卫生间。主卧室里摆着一张大双人床，两个床头柜，一个躺椅，还有一个很大的衣橱。我的房间在三楼，三楼是一个阁楼，有一个卫生间，还有一个很小的活动室。我喜欢有自己的空间。我们的房子还有一个地下室和一个车库。地下室是我们的健身房和游戏室。车库里除了停车，还放着爸爸的很多工具。他最喜欢在那儿做木工。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā zài huá shèng dùn zhōu de xī yǎ tú shì wǒ men jiā de fáng zi shì yí gè sān céng lóu de fáng zi fáng zi de qián biān yǒu yí gè xiǎo huā yuán lǐ biān zhòng zhe hěn duō piào liàng de huā hòu biān shì gè dà yuàn zi lǐ miàn zhòng zhe yì xiē shū cài hé guǒ shù wǒ jiā de wū dǐng shì shēn kā fēi sè de wài qiáng shì qiǎn huáng sè de dà mén shì hóng sè de jìn mén hòu nǐ huì kàn jiàn yí gè dà kè tīng kè tīng lǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng cháng shā fā yí gè liǎng rén shā fā hé yì zhāng kā fēi zhuō kè tīng de hòu qiáng shàng yǒu sì gè dà chuāng hù suǒ yǐ kè tīng hěn míng liàng kè tīng de duì miàn shì chú fáng chú fáng de páng biān shì fàn tīng fàn tīng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng fàn zhuō hé liù bǎ yǐ zi kè tīng de zuǒ biān shì shū fáng shū fáng hěn xiǎo zhǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng bàn gōng zhuō yí gè shū jià hé yì tái diàn nǎo shū fáng de páng biān shì gè wèi shēng jiān èr lóu yǒu sān gè wò shì dì yī gè fáng jiān shì wǒ dì di de fáng jiān páng biān shì yí gè wèi shēng jiān zhè ge wèi shēng jiān shì wǒ dì di hé mèi mèi gòng yòng de wèi shēng jiān de yòu biān shì wǒ mèi mèi de fáng jiān zuì lǐ miàn shì wǒ bà bà mā mā zhù de zhǔ wò shì tā men yǒu zì jǐ de wèi shēng jiān zhǔ wò shì lǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng dà shuāng rén chuáng liǎng gè chuáng tóu guì yí gè tǎng yǐ hái yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yī chú wǒ de fáng jiān zài sān lóu sān lóu shì yí gè gé lóu yǒu yí gè wèi shēng jiān hái yǒu yí gè hěn xiǎo de huó dòng shì wǒ xǐ huān yǒu zì jǐ de kōng jiān wǒ men de fáng zi hái yǒu yí gè dì xià shì hé yí gè chē kù dì xià shì shì wǒ men de jiàn shēn fáng hé yóu xì shì chē kù lǐ chú le tíng chē hái fàng zhe bà bà de hěn duō gōng jù tā zuì xǐ huān zài nàr zuò mù gōng — My family lives in Seattle, Washington State. Our house is a three-story house. In front of the house there is a small garden planted with many pretty flowers. Behind is a big yard planted with some vegetables and fruit trees. The roof of our house is dark brown, the outer walls are light yellow, and the front door is red. After you enter the door, you will see a big living room; in it are placed a long sofa, a two-seater sofa and a coffee table. On the back wall of the living room there are four big windows, so the living room is very bright. Across from the living room is the kitchen, and next to the kitchen is the dining room, which has a dining table and six chairs. To the left of the living room is the study; the study is very small and has only a desk, a bookshelf and a computer. Next to the study is a bathroom. On the second floor there are three bedrooms. The first room is my younger brother’s, next to it is a bathroom shared by my younger brother and sister. To the right of the bathroom is my younger sister’s room. At the very back is the master bedroom where my parents live; they have their own bathroom. In the master bedroom are a big double bed, two nightstands, a recliner, and a very big closet. My room is on the third floor, which is an attic with a bathroom and a very small activity room. I like having my own space. Our house also has a basement and a garage. The basement is our gym and game room. In the garage, besides parking, there are also many of Dad’s tools. He likes to do woodworking there best.

explanations.title: Activity 7: 外国人也能在中国“扫码”
explanations.body: A. Read the headline of the news article (中国网事—外国人在中国, written by 王武). What new development do you think the article is reporting? Compare answers with a partner. The book prints digits (20%, 2018, 95万); they are spelled out here. Reference: xinhuanet.com.

examples.text: 以前，外国人因为没有中国国内银行卡或手机号码等，往往无法注册使用中国移动支付。现在，支付宝、微信支付可以跟国外银行卡绑定，为很多外国朋友在中国使用移动支付打开了“方便之门”。在中国工作或学习的外国人，在购物付款的时候，比如是“扫码”支付，还是现金、刷卡支付，就会告诉中国人他们来中国多长时间了。美国留学生琳达说，“我看到在中国几乎所有的商店都有移动支付的二维码，扫一扫付款，又快又方便。”这是她第二次来中国，两年前第一次来的时候，因为需要中国银行卡和手机号才能成功注册，她没有办法使用中国的移动支付。琳达说，在美国她常常使用现金和信用卡，而在中国大多数人“扫码”就可以支付。百分之二十的外国网友说不能像中国人一样用手机支付，是他们来中国时最大的麻烦。“我的两位中国室友帮助我开通了移动支付。用手机什么都可以‘扫一扫’，超级快，非常好用。”来自法国的马克说。二零一八年在中国工作的外国人已经有九十五万人。很多来中国学习、工作、生活的外国人跟琳达和马克一样，都已经习惯了移动支付的方便，除了购物、付房租、订餐以外，他们也用移动支付买机票、付学费什么的。
examples.translation: yǐ qián wài guó rén yīn wèi méi yǒu zhōng guó guó nèi yín háng kǎ huò shǒu jī hào mǎ děng wǎng wǎng wú fǎ zhù cè shǐ yòng zhōng guó yí dòng zhī fù xiàn zài zhī fù bǎo wēi xìn zhī fù kě yǐ gēn guó wài yín háng kǎ bǎng dìng wèi hěn duō wài guó péng yǒu zài zhōng guó shǐ yòng yí dòng zhī fù dǎ kāi le fāng biàn zhī mén zài zhōng guó gōng zuò huò xué xí de wài guó rén zài gòu wù fù kuǎn de shí hòu bǐ rú shì sǎo mǎ zhī fù hái shì xiàn jīn shuā kǎ zhī fù jiù huì gào sù zhōng guó rén tā men lái zhōng guó duō cháng shí jiān le měi guó liú xué shēng lín dá shuō wǒ kàn dào zài zhōng guó jī hū suǒ yǒu de shāng diàn dōu yǒu yí dòng zhī fù de èr wéi mǎ sǎo yì sǎo fù kuǎn yòu kuài yòu fāng biàn zhè shì tā dì èr cì lái zhōng guó liǎng nián qián dì yī cì lái de shí hòu yīn wèi xū yào zhōng guó yín háng kǎ hé shǒu jī hào cái néng chéng gōng zhù cè tā méi yǒu bàn fǎ shǐ yòng zhōng guó de yí dòng zhī fù lín dá shuō zài měi guó tā cháng cháng shǐ yòng xiàn jīn hé xìn yòng kǎ ér zài zhōng guó dà duō shù rén sǎo mǎ jiù kě yǐ zhī fù bǎi fēn zhī èr shí de wài guó wǎng yǒu shuō bù néng xiàng zhōng guó rén yí yàng yòng shǒu jī zhī fù shì tā men lái zhōng guó shí zuì dà de má fán wǒ de liǎng wèi zhōng guó shì yǒu bāng zhù wǒ kāi tōng le yí dòng zhī fù yòng shǒu jī shén me dōu kě yǐ sǎo yì sǎo chāo jí kuài fēi cháng hǎo yòng lái zì fǎ guó de mǎ kè shuō èr líng yī bā nián zài zhōng guó gōng zuò de wài guó rén yǐ jīng yǒu jiǔ shí wǔ wàn rén hěn duō lái zhōng guó xué xí gōng zuò shēng huó de wài guó rén gēn lín dá hé mǎ kè yí yàng dōu yǐ jīng xí guàn le yí dòng zhī fù de fāng biàn chú le gòu wù fù fáng zū dìng cān yǐ wài tā men yě yòng yí dòng zhī fù mǎi jī piào fù xué fèi shén me de — In the past, because foreigners did not have a Chinese domestic bank card or phone number, they often could not register to use Chinese mobile payment. Now Alipay and WeChat Pay can be linked to foreign bank cards, opening a “door of convenience” for many foreign friends using mobile payment in China. When foreigners working or studying in China pay for purchases, whether they pay by “scanning the code” or by cash or card, it tells Chinese people how long they have been in China. Linda, an American study-abroad student, says, “I see that in China almost every store has a mobile payment QR code, and scanning to pay is both fast and convenient.” This is her second time in China; two years ago on her first visit, because a Chinese bank card and phone number were needed to register successfully, she had no way to use Chinese mobile payment. Linda says that in the U.S. she often uses cash and credit cards, while in China most people can pay by “scanning the code”. Twenty percent of foreign netizens say that not being able to pay by phone like Chinese people is the biggest trouble when they come to China. “My two Chinese roommates helped me turn on mobile payment. With a phone you can ‘scan’ anything; it’s super fast and very easy to use,” says Mark, who comes from France. In 2018 there were already 950,000 foreigners working in China. Many foreigners who come to China to study, work and live, like Linda and Mark, have gotten used to the convenience of mobile payment; besides shopping, paying rent and ordering meals, they also use mobile payment to buy plane tickets, pay tuition and so on.

explanations.title: Activity 7 B and the statements
explanations.body: B. Read the article again and mark the statements true or false. The book’s statement 3 runs on into the line numbered 4 (the numbering glitches), so there are six statements; the answers are mine from the article: 1. 以前外国人在中国不能扫码支付。 (True: they often could not register.) 2. 现在外国人可以很方便地在中国使用国外银行卡付款。 (True.) 3. 中国人只要看外国人是用“扫码”支付，还是现金、刷卡支付，就可以知道他们来中国多长时间了。 (True, as the article puts it.) 4. 琳达一到中国，就学会了“扫码”支付。 (False: her first time she had no way to use it.) 5. 大多数的外国人说不能用手机支付是他们在中国最大的麻烦。 (False: it is twenty percent.) 6. 现在在中国的外国人已经习惯了手机支付，连学费和房租也用扫码支付。 (True.) C. Translate the sentences below, two for you and two for your partner, then review each other’s work. My translations:

examples.text: 以前，外国人因为没有中国国内银行卡或手机号码等，往往无法注册使用中国移动支付。现在，支付宝、微信支付可以跟国外银行卡绑定，为很多外国朋友在中国使用移动支付打开了“方便之门”。
examples.translation: yǐ qián wài guó rén yīn wèi méi yǒu zhōng guó guó nèi yín háng kǎ huò shǒu jī hào mǎ děng wǎng wǎng wú fǎ zhù cè shǐ yòng zhōng guó yí dòng zhī fù xiàn zài zhī fù bǎo wēi xìn zhī fù kě yǐ gēn guó wài yín háng kǎ bǎng dìng wèi hěn duō wài guó péng yǒu zài zhōng guó shǐ yòng yí dòng zhī fù dǎ kāi le fāng biàn zhī mén — In the past, because foreigners did not have a Chinese bank card or phone number, they often could not register for Chinese mobile payment. Now Alipay and WeChat Pay can be linked to foreign bank cards, opening a “door of convenience” for many foreign friends.

examples.text: 在中国工作或学习的外国人，在购物付款的时候，比如是“扫码”支付，还是现金、刷卡支付，就会告诉中国人他们来中国多长时间了。
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó gōng zuò huò xué xí de wài guó rén zài gòu wù fù kuǎn de shí hòu bǐ rú shì sǎo mǎ zhī fù hái shì xiàn jīn shuā kǎ zhī fù jiù huì gào sù zhōng guó rén tā men lái zhōng guó duō cháng shí jiān le — When foreigners working or studying in China pay, whether by “scanning the code” or by cash or card, it tells Chinese people how long they have been in China.

examples.text: 百分之二十的外国网友说不能像中国人一样用手机支付，是他们来中国时最大的麻烦。
examples.translation: bǎi fēn zhī èr shí de wài guó wǎng yǒu shuō bù néng xiàng zhōng guó rén yí yàng yòng shǒu jī zhī fù shì tā men lái zhōng guó shí zuì dà de má fán — Twenty percent of foreign netizens say that not being able to pay by phone like Chinese people is their biggest trouble in China.

examples.text: 很多来中国学习、工作、生活的外国人跟琳达和马克一样，都已经习惯了移动支付的方便，除了购物、付房租、订餐以外，他们也用移动支付买机票、付学费什么的。

lessons.title: 297. Lesson 12 (Unit 2 review): using Chinese in context review
lessons.subtitle: 生活如何？ · 同乐会菜单 · 买礼物 · 出租启事 · 银行和微信支付

explanations.title: Activity 1: life at DLI
explanations.body: A. A Chinese friend emails you (the subject is 生活如何？) to ask about life at DLI and lists ten questions. B. Ask a partner the questions in the email and write their answers. C. Write an email in pinyin or characters to answer your friend. The ten questions:

examples.text: 每天早上几点起床？几点集合？
examples.translation: měi tiān zǎo shàng jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng jǐ diǎn jí hé — What time do you get up every morning? What time do you fall in?

examples.text: 每天几点上课，几点下课？中午在哪儿吃午饭？
examples.translation: měi tiān jǐ diǎn shàng kè jǐ diǎn xià kè zhōng wǔ zài nǎr chī wǔ fàn — What time do classes start and end every day? Where do you eat lunch?

examples.text: 每天上几节课？上午几节课？下午几节课？
examples.translation: měi tiān shàng jǐ jié kè shàng wǔ jǐ jié kè xià wǔ jǐ jié kè — How many classes a day? How many in the morning? How many in the afternoon?

examples.text: 每天都有什么课？
examples.translation: měi tiān dōu yǒu shén me kè — What classes are there every day?

examples.text: 每天的作业多不多？需要多长时间做完作业？
examples.translation: měi tiān de zuò yè duō bù duō xū yào duō cháng shí jiān zuò wán zuò yè — Is there a lot of homework every day? How long does it take to finish?

examples.text: 考试多不多？都有什么考试？考得怎么样？
examples.translation: kǎo shì duō bù duō dōu yǒu shén me kǎo shì kǎo de zěn me yàng — Are there many tests? What tests are there? How did you do?

examples.text: 周末几点起床？几点睡觉？
examples.translation: zhōu mò jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng jǐ diǎn shuì jiào — What time do you get up and go to bed on weekends?

examples.text: 星期六常常做什么？
examples.translation: xīng qī liù cháng cháng zuò shén me — What do you often do on Saturdays?

examples.text: 星期天常常做什么？
examples.translation: xīng qī tiān cháng cháng zuò shén me — What do you often do on Sundays?

examples.text: 有没有其它想要让你父母知道的？
examples.translation: yǒu méi yǒu qí tā xiǎng yào ràng nǐ fù mǔ zhī dào de — Is there anything else you want your parents to know?

explanations.title: Activity 2: a Chinese potluck
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three to plan a Chinese potluck for your class. In Chinese, brainstorm a menu and write at least three items for each category: 1. 饮料, 2. 餐具, 3. 主食, 4. 菜 (with its 特色: 味道, 地方, 民族等), 5. 水果, 6. 甜点. B. With another group, combine your two menus into a final menu and present it to the class on butcher block paper.

explanations.title: Activity 3: role play at the department store
explanations.body: A. You are working in Shanghai but want to celebrate Christmas in the U.S. Before leaving, you buy gifts for your family at a department store; your partner plays the sales associate. B. Switch roles and repeat. The customer may buy: 衣服, 皮鞋, 领带, 衬衫, 西装, 袜子, 裤子, 围巾, 毛巾, 牙刷, 牙膏, 书包, 笔记本, 圆珠笔, 其它; and may ask the sales associate: 1. 每个东西多少钱 2. 有没有打折、促销或是优惠. The sales associate may ask the customer: 1. 衣服的颜色: 蓝色, 黑色, 红色等 2. 衣服的大小: 小号, 中号, 大号 3. 穿多大号码的鞋 4. 怎么付钱: 现金, 信用卡, 微信.

explanations.title: Activity 4: a rental ad
explanations.body: A. Pair up. You and a MIIS classmate rent a house and want to share it with a Chinese student. Write a rental ad in Chinese on butcher block or a large sheet of paper, addressing these ten questions. B. Post the ad on the classroom wall and read other pairs’ ads. C. With a different partner, role-play the MIIS housemate while your partner plays the Chinese student who calls about your room for rent. D. Switch to a third partner and play the Chinese student. The questions:

examples.text: 房子在哪儿？房子有几层楼？什么颜色？
examples.translation: fáng zi zài nǎr fáng zi yǒu jǐ céng lóu shén me yán sè — Where is the house? How many floors does it have? What color is it?

examples.text: 出租的房间每月房租是多少？包不包水电费，上网费？
examples.translation: chū zū de fáng jiān měi yuè fáng zū shì duō shǎo bāo bù bāo shuǐ diàn fèi shàng wǎng fèi — How much is the monthly rent for the room? Are water, electricity and internet included?

examples.text: 房子的外面什么样？有没有院子？院子里种着什么？
examples.translation: fáng zi de wài miàn shén me yàng yǒu méi yǒu yuàn zi yuàn zi lǐ zhòng zhe shén me — What does the outside look like? Is there a yard? What is planted in it?

examples.text: 房子有几个卧室？你的卧室, 你朋友的卧室, 房客的卧室都在哪儿？
examples.translation: fáng zi yǒu jǐ gè wò shì nǐ de wò shì nǐ péng yǒu de wò shì fáng kè de wò shì dōu zài nǎr — How many bedrooms? Where are your bedroom, your friend’s bedroom and the tenant’s bedroom?

examples.text: 房客的卧室带不带家具？如果带家具，都有什么？
examples.translation: fáng kè de wò shì dài bú dài jiā jù rú guǒ dài jiā jù dōu yǒu shén me — Does the tenant’s bedroom come with furniture? If so, what?

examples.text: 房客可不可以在厨房做饭？如果可以，你有什么厨具？
examples.translation: fáng kè kě bù kě yǐ zài chú fáng zuò fàn rú guǒ kě yǐ nǐ yǒu shén me chú jù — May the tenant cook in the kitchen? If so, what kitchenware do you have?

examples.text: 如果房客喜欢你的房子，什么时候可以住进来？
examples.translation: rú guǒ fáng kè xǐ huān nǐ de fáng zi shén me shí hòu kě yǐ zhù jìn lái — If the tenant likes your house, when can they move in?

examples.text: 要不要付押金？付多少押金？
examples.translation: yào bú yào fù yā jīn fù duō shǎo yā jīn — Is a deposit required? How much?

examples.text: 你要找什么样的房客？哪国人？男的还是女的？做什么工作？
examples.translation: nǐ yào zhǎo shén me yàng de fáng kè nǎ guó rén nán de hái shì nǚ de zuò shén me gōng zuò — What kind of tenant are you looking for? Which nationality? Male or female? What job?

examples.text: 联系人是谁？联系电话号码是多少？
examples.translation: lián xì rén shì shuí lián xì diàn huà hào mǎ shì duō shǎo — Who is the contact person? What is the contact phone number?

explanations.title: Activity 5: banking at the Chinese University of Hong Kong
explanations.body: You are nearing completion of a one-year Education Abroad Program at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. The EAP director asks you to make a Chinese PowerPoint presentation for next year’s students to show them how to open a bank account, register for online banking, and use WeChat Pay. A. Divide into three groups: Group A lists the steps for opening a bank account (怎么开银行账户; 怎么把美元换成人民币), Group B the steps for setting up online accounts and banking services (怎么注册网上银行; 介绍网上银行业务), and Group C the steps for using WeChat Pay (怎么注册移动支付). B. Present your work to the class in Chinese and explain the benefits of using these services. C. Consolidate the work of all three groups into one PowerPoint.

units.title: 第十三课 人在机场 Presentation 1: check-in, 的 phrases, 往, 好/完, directional verbs

lessons.title: 313. Lesson 13 Presentation 1: check-in at the airport
lessons.subtitle: 第十三课 人在机场 · 我想换一下座位 · 大的托运，小的我随身带 · 十九号登机口怎么走？

explanations.title: 第十三课 人在机场: Lesson 13 At the Airport, learning objectives
explanations.body: Upon completion of this lesson you will be able to check in at the airport, process customs entry, go through a security check, and give simple directions. To do this you must master new words and phrases for these functions, formulaic expressions for functioning at the airport, and the grammar: the 的 phrase as a noun, the directional 往, the resultative complements 好 and 完, the simple directional verbs, the measure word for verbs 次, the 到 + place + verb construction, simple directional verbs used to indicate the direction of an action, 因此 (therefore) versus 所以, …的样子, 原来 (as it turned out), and the conditional 要是…就….

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. When was the last time you took a flight? B. What identification did you need to board? C. How many pieces of luggage did you have? D. What kind of seat do you prefer on the airplane? E. List the stages of a plane journey from check-in to arrival.

explanations.title: Presentation 1: at the check-in desk
explanations.body: David talks to the check-in agent (the book also prints the dialog in traditional characters). The seat letter is written in full-width form here so that the Chinese is spoken without Latin letters.

examples.text: 服务员：您好！您要办登机手续吗？
examples.translation: fú wù yuán nín hǎo nín yào bàn dēng jī shǒu xù ma — Hello! Do you want to go through check-in?

examples.text: 大卫：登机手续我已经办好了，可是，我想换一下座位。
examples.translation: dà wèi dēng jī shǒu xù wǒ yǐ jīng bàn hǎo le kě shì wǒ xiǎng huàn yí xià zuò wèi — I’ve already completed check-in, but I’d like to change my seat.

examples.text: 服务员：请先让我看一下您的护照和登机牌。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán qǐng xiān ràng wǒ kàn yí xià nín de hù zhào hé dēng jī pái — Please let me see your passport and boarding pass first.

examples.text: 大卫：在这儿，给您。
examples.translation: dà wèi zài zhèr gěi nín — Here you are.

examples.text: 服务员：您要换什么座位？
examples.translation: fú wù yuán nín yào huàn shén me zuò wèi — What seat do you want to change to?

examples.text: 大卫：我订的是靠走道的座位，我想换成靠窗户的。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ dìng de shì kào zǒu dào de zuò wèi wǒ xiǎng huàn chéng kào chuāng hù de — I booked an aisle seat; I’d like to change to a window seat.

examples.text: 服务员：请稍等，让我查一下。十五排Ａ座可以吗？
examples.translation: fú wù yuán qǐng shāo děng ràng wǒ chá yí xià shí wǔ pái zuò kě yǐ ma — Please wait a moment, let me check. Is seat A in row 15 all right?

examples.text: 大卫：可以。
examples.translation: dà wèi kě yǐ — Yes.

examples.text: 服务员：您要托运行李吗？
examples.translation: fú wù yuán nín yào tuō yùn xíng li ma — Are you checking any luggage?

examples.text: 大卫：这件大的托运，小的我随身带。
examples.translation: dà wèi zhè jiàn dà de tuō yùn xiǎo de wǒ suí shēn dài — I’ll check this big one and carry the small one on.

examples.text: 服务员：请您把行李放这儿称一下。好了。这是您的行李牌。请到那边过安检。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán qǐng nín bǎ xíng li fàng zhèr chēng yí xià hǎo le zhè shì nín de xíng li pái qǐng dào nà biān guò ān jiǎn — Please put your luggage here to be weighed. All done. Here is your luggage tag. Please go over there through security.

examples.text: 大卫：请问，十九号登机口怎么走？
examples.translation: dà wèi qǐng wèn shí jiǔ hào dēng jī kǒu zěn me zǒu — Excuse me, how do I get to Gate 19?

examples.text: 服务员：过了安检，往左拐，坐电梯上二楼，出了电梯往前走，右边第三个登机口就是。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán guò le ān jiǎn wǎng zuǒ guǎi zuò diàn tī shàng èr lóu chū le diàn tī wǎng qián zǒu yòu biān dì sān gè dēng jī kǒu jiù shì — After security, turn left, take the elevator up to the second floor, and after getting out of the elevator walk straight ahead; it’s the third boarding gate on the right.

examples.text: 大卫：谢谢！
examples.translation: dà wèi xiè xiè — Thank you!

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening). A. Global listening: where did the conversation take place, and what tasks did the passenger accomplish? B. Detailed listening: 1. What documents was the passenger asked for? 2. What accommodation did he request, and was it satisfied? 3. How many pieces of check-in and carry-on luggage did he have? 4. What was his next stop? 5. What was his last question at the counter? (Audio, not included. From the dialog: passport and boarding pass; he asked for a window seat instead of an aisle seat and got seat A in row 15; one big piece to check and a small one to carry on; security; how to get to Gate 19.) Activity 2 (Reading and Writing). A. Using the presentation, fill in the blanks in the paragraph with pinyin or characters (the book’s blanks are empty; the completed paragraph below is mine). B. Pair up, read your passage to your partner and discuss your work.

examples.text: 我已经办好登机手续了。我对服务员说，我想换一下座位。我的座位是靠走道的，我想换成靠窗户的。服务员看了我的护照和登机牌。换完座位以后，我还要托运行李。我有两件行李，大的托运，小的我随身带。服务员把行李牌给我，让我去过安检，他还告诉我怎么去十九号登机口。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ jīng bàn hǎo dēng jī shǒu xù le wǒ duì fú wù yuán shuō wǒ xiǎng huàn yí xià zuò wèi wǒ de zuò wèi shì kào zǒu dào de wǒ xiǎng huàn chéng kào chuāng hù de fú wù yuán kàn le wǒ de hù zhào hé dēng jī pái huàn wán zuò wèi yǐ hòu wǒ hái yào tuō yùn xíng li wǒ yǒu liǎng jiàn xíng li dà de tuō yùn xiǎo de wǒ suí shēn dài fú wù yuán bǎ xíng li pái gěi wǒ ràng wǒ qù guò ān jiǎn tā hái gào sù wǒ zěn me qù shí jiǔ hào dēng jī kǒu — I have already completed check-in. I told the agent I’d like to change my seat. My seat is an aisle one and I want to change to a window one. The agent looked at my passport and boarding pass. After changing seats I still have to check my luggage. I have two pieces of luggage; I check the big one and carry the small one on. The agent gave me the luggage tag, told me to go through security, and also told me how to get to Gate 19.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking): at the check-in desk
explanations.body: Below are requests, instructions or questions a passenger may hear at the check-in desk. Pair up: one student plays the check-in agent, the other the passenger; switch roles after the first round. The book gives them in English in four groups: 1. First the agent asks for your ticket and ID. 2. Then the agent takes your luggage. 3. They might ask your seat preference. 4. The clerk tells you your gate number and boarding time. A Chinese version of each (mine):

examples.text: 请让我看一下您的机票。
examples.translation: qǐng ràng wǒ kàn yí xià nín de jī piào — Can I see your ticket, please?

examples.text: 您带护照了吗？
examples.translation: nín dài hù zhào le ma — Do you have your passport with you?

examples.text: 您要托运几件行李？
examples.translation: nín yào tuō yùn jǐ jiàn xíng li — How many pieces of luggage are you checking in?

examples.text: 您有随身带的行李吗？
examples.translation: nín yǒu suí shēn dài de xíng li ma — Do you have any carry-on bags?

examples.text: 请您把行李放在这儿。
examples.translation: qǐng nín bǎ xíng li fàng zài zhèr — Would you place your bag on the counter?

examples.text: 您想要靠走道的座位还是靠窗户的座位？
examples.translation: nín xiǎng yào kào zǒu dào de zuò wèi hái shì kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi — Would you like an aisle or window seat?

examples.text: 靠走道的座位没有了，靠窗户的可以吗？
examples.translation: kào zǒu dào de zuò wèi méi yǒu le kào chuāng hù de kě yǐ ma — We do not have any aisle seats remaining. Is a window seat OK with you?

examples.text: 这是您的登机牌。
examples.translation: zhè shì nín de dēng jī pái — Here is your boarding pass.

examples.text: 您在八号登机口上飞机。
examples.translation: nín zài bā hào dēng jī kǒu shàng fēi jī — You will board at Gate 8.

explanations.title: Activities 4 and 5
explanations.body: Activity 4 (Listening). Listen to the passage and answer: 1. What kind of seat does the passenger prefer? 2. How many pieces of luggage will he check in, and which bags can he carry on the plane? (Audio, not included.) Activity 5 (Reading). Read the conversation between David and the check-in agent and answer the questions. New word: 转机 (zhuǎnjī): transfer. 1. What is David’s destination? 2. How many pieces of luggage did he check in? 3. Where should he claim his checked-in luggage? 4. Why is his flight stopping at Beijing? (Mine: Hong Kong; one; in Hong Kong; because he is transferring there.) The seat is written in the book as 26E.

examples.text: 服务员：下午好！请问您的飞机到哪里？

examples.text: 大卫：到香港。

examples.text: 服务员：请让我看一下您的护照。

examples.text: 大卫：这是我的护照。
examples.translation: dà wèi zhè shì wǒ de hù zhào — Here is my passport.

examples.text: 服务员：您有需要托运的行李吗？
examples.translation: fú wù yuán nín yǒu xū yào tuō yùn de xíng li ma — Do you have luggage to check?

examples.text: 大卫：就这一件。

lessons.title: 314. Lesson 13 Presentation 1 grammar: X 的 as a noun
lessons.subtitle: 靠窗户的 · 大的托运，小的我随身带 · 去北京的 · 住的、吃的、用的

explanations.title: X 的 as a noun
explanations.body: David said: 1. 我订的是靠走道的座位，我想换成靠窗户的。 2. 这件大的托运，小的我随身带。 In example 1, David meant he wants a 靠窗户的座位 but left out the word 座位. In example 2 he meant to check the 大的行李 and carry on the 小的行李, leaving out 行李. In Chinese, when an object (a person or thing) is known to both speaker and listener in a context, its modifier + 的 (the 的 phrase) can be used to represent the object. The modifier can be a noun, pronoun, adjective, verb or a subject + predicate phrase. Patterns: N/NP/ProN + 的 = N/NP/ProN + 的 + Object; ADJ/ADJP + 的 = ADJ + 的 + Object; V/VP + 的 = V/VP + 的 + Object; SP + 的 = SP + 的 + Object. The function of 的 phrases as nouns is to refer to and differentiate things. The book gives each example followed by its fuller equivalent:

examples.text: 去北京的请去二十六号登机口，去南京的请去十二号登机口。
examples.translation: qù běi jīng de qǐng qù èr shí liù hào dēng jī kǒu qù nán jīng de qǐng qù shí èr hào dēng jī kǒu — Those going to Beijing please go to Gate 26; those going to Nanjing please go to Gate 12.

examples.text: 去北京的人请去二十六号登机口，去南京的人请去十二号登机口。
examples.translation: qù běi jīng de rén qǐng qù èr shí liù hào dēng jī kǒu qù nán jīng de rén qǐng qù shí èr hào dēng jī kǒu — (the same with 人 written out)

examples.text: 这两个座位，靠窗户的是我的，靠走道的是你的。
examples.translation: zhè liǎng gè zuò wèi kào chuāng hù de shì wǒ de kào zǒu dào de shì nǐ de — Of these two seats, the window one is mine and the aisle one is yours.

examples.text: 这两个座位，靠窗户的座位是我的座位，靠走道的座位是你的座位。
examples.translation: zhè liǎng gè zuò wèi kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi shì wǒ de zuò wèi kào zǒu dào de zuò wèi shì nǐ de zuò wèi — (the same with 座位 written out)

examples.text: 这两件行李，大的托运，小的我随身带。
examples.translation: zhè liǎng jiàn xíng li dà de tuō yùn xiǎo de wǒ suí shēn dài — Of these two pieces of luggage, the big one I check and the small one I carry on.

examples.text: 这两个行李，大的行李托运，小的行李我随身带。
examples.translation: zhè liǎng gè xíng li dà de xíng li tuō yùn xiǎo de xíng li wǒ suí shēn dài — (the same with 行李 written out; the book writes 个 here)

examples.text: 说到饺子啊，老张包的比老陈包的好吃。
examples.translation: shuō dào jiǎo zi a lǎo zhāng bāo de bǐ lǎo chén bāo de hǎo chī — Speaking of dumplings, the ones Lao Zhang makes taste better than the ones Lao Chen makes.

examples.text: 说到饺子啊，老张包的饺子比老陈包的饺子好吃。
examples.translation: shuō dào jiǎo zi a lǎo zhāng bāo de jiǎo zi bǐ lǎo chén bāo de jiǎo zi hǎo chī — (the same with 饺子 written out)

examples.text: 美国军人生活不错，住的、吃的、用的都是国家给的。是吗？
examples.translation: měi guó jūn rén shēng huó bú cuò zhù de chī de yòng de dōu shì guó jiā gěi de shì ma — American service members live well; what they live in, eat and use are all given by the country. Is that so?

examples.text: 美国军人生活不错，住的地方、吃的东西、用的东西都是国家给的。是吗？

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Writing and Speaking). You accompany your friend to do chores and paraphrase his expressions with 的 phrases when you think he is too wordy. Take turns playing 你的朋友 and 你. 1. At the bank: 我要换二百美元人民币。请给我十张一百元的人民币，六张五十元的人民币。 2. Renting: 你们两个卧室的公寓多少钱？一个卧室的公寓多少钱？ 3. Buying fruit: 好看一点儿的水果新鲜还是不好看的水果新鲜？ 4. At the restaurant: 我要喝冷的茶，不要热的茶。 The book starts each of your answers (我朋友说/问，…) and leaves them to you; my completions:

examples.text: 我朋友说，他要换二百美元人民币，要十张一百块的，六张五十块的。

examples.translation: wǒ péng yǒu wèn nǐ men de gōng yù liǎng gè wò shì de duō shǎo qián yí gè wò shì de duō shǎo qián — My friend asks, of your apartments, how much is the two-bedroom one and how much is the one-bedroom one?

examples.text: 我朋友问，这些水果，好看一点儿的新鲜还是不好看的新鲜？
examples.translation: wǒ péng yǒu wèn zhè xiē shuǐ guǒ hǎo kàn yì diǎnr de xīn xiān hái shì bù hǎo kàn de xīn xiān — My friend asks, of these fruits, are the better-looking ones fresher or the not-so-good-looking ones?

examples.text: 我朋友说，他的茶，要冷的，不要热的。
examples.translation: wǒ péng yǒu shuō tā de chá yào lěng de bú yào rè de — My friend says, for his tea, he wants the cold one, not the hot one.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Each person uses 的 phrases to describe a person or an object and the other guesses what it is. The book’s example describes a smartboard:

lessons.title: 315. Lesson 13 Presentation 1 grammar: the preposition 往
lessons.subtitle: 往左拐 · 往前走 · 往南走 · 飞往纽约 · 前往洛杉矶

explanations.title: Preposition 往
explanations.body: The basic meaning of 往 is “moving toward” or “in the direction of”. 往 takes a directional or a place noun to form a “往 phrase”, which precedes a verb: 往 + Direction + Verb. In written language, 往 can also be used after a few monosyllabic verbs (飞, 开, 发, 送, 寄, 运) as a directional complement meaning “to go in the direction of”: Verb + 往 + Direction/Location. (The book prints the numbers as digits: 200 米, 257 次航班.)

examples.text: 你下车以后往南走，十分钟就到了。
examples.translation: nǐ xià chē yǐ hòu wǎng nán zǒu shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le — After you get off the bus walk south; you’ll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: 往前走两百米就是图书馆。
examples.translation: wǎng qián zǒu liǎng bǎi mǐ jiù shì tú shū guǎn — Walk forward two hundred meters and there is the library.

examples.text: 过了红绿灯往左拐。
examples.translation: guò le hóng lǜ dēng wǎng zuǒ guǎi — After the traffic light turn left.

examples.text: 你往上看。
examples.translation: nǐ wǎng shàng kàn — Look up.

examples.text: 二百五十七次航班飞往纽约。
examples.translation: èr bǎi wǔ shí qī cì háng bān fēi wǎng niǔ yuē — Flight 257 flies to New York.

examples.text: 开往南方的火车有很多。

examples.text: 请把这件行李运往重庆。
examples.translation: qǐng bǎ zhè jiàn xíng li yùn wǎng chóng qìng — Please ship this piece of luggage to Chongqing.

lessons.title: 316. Lesson 13 Presentation 1 grammar: resultative complements 好 and 完
lessons.subtitle: 办好了 · 做完作业了 · 准备好了吗？ · “做完”和“做好”

explanations.title: Resultative Complement and 好、完
explanations.body: A complement is a grammatical unit in Chinese. It appears after the main verb to enhance its meaning. Resultative complements indicate the resultative aspect of an action. We learned the resultative complement 完 in Lesson 9, as in 买完文具以后, 他又开始选购衣服. 完 indicates finishing an action, while 好 indicates the completion of an action and/or achieving the desired results. When 好 indicates only the completion of an action, it is interchangeable with 完. In the presentation David says 手续我已经办好了 (or 我已经办好手续了): “I have already completed the boarding procedures.” Patterns: Object + Subject + Verb + Resultative Complement + 了. Subject + Verb + Resultative Complement + Object + 了. Question: Subject + Verb + Resultative Complement + Object + 了 + 吗/没有？ Negative: Subject + 没有 + Verb + Resultative Complement + Object.

examples.text: 我做完作业了。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò wán zuò yè le — I’ve finished my homework.

examples.text: 我吃好饭了。
examples.translation: wǒ chī hǎo fàn le — I’ve finished eating.

examples.text: 我还没有锻炼完。
examples.translation: wǒ hái méi yǒu duàn liàn wán — I haven’t finished working out yet.

examples.text: 你买完东西了吗？
examples.translation: nǐ mǎi wán dōng xī le ma — Have you finished buying things?

examples.text: 你做完功课了没有？
examples.translation: nǐ zuò wán gōng kè le méi yǒu — Have you finished your homework?

examples.text: 饭菜已经做好了。
examples.translation: fàn cài yǐ jīng zuò hǎo le — The meal is already prepared.

examples.text: 信用卡已经办好了。
examples.translation: xìn yòng kǎ yǐ jīng bàn hǎo le — The credit card has already been taken care of.

explanations.title: Activities 5 and 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Listening and Writing). Listen to the dialog between Xiaoming and his mother and answer: 1. When did the conversation most likely take place? 2. When does Xiaoming plan to do his homework? 3. Why does the mother ask 你吃好了吗？ 4. What will Xiaoming probably do when his homework is finished? (Audio, not included.) Activity 6 (Reading, Writing and Speaking). A. Complete the sentences with the correct resultative complement, 完 or 好. B. Share your work with a classmate and discuss any differences. The blanks are empty in the book; the completed exchanges are mine:

examples.text: 甲：准备好了吗？准备好了我们就开始。
examples.translation: jiǎ zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma zhǔn bèi hǎo le wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ — Are you ready? Once you’re ready we’ll start.

examples.text: 乙：准备好了。

examples.text: 甲：你锻炼完了吗？锻炼完了我们一起去吃饭。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ duàn liàn wán le ma duàn liàn wán le wǒ men yì qǐ qù chī fàn — Have you finished working out? When you’re done we’ll go eat together.

examples.text: 乙：还有几分钟就锻炼完了。
examples.translation: yǐ hái yǒu jǐ fēn zhōng jiù duàn liàn wán le — In a few minutes I’ll be done.

examples.text: 甲：饮料喝完了吗？喝完了我再买。
examples.translation: jiǎ yǐn liào hē wán le ma hē wán le wǒ zài mǎi — Have you finished the drinks? When they’re finished I’ll buy more.

examples.text: 乙：还没喝完呢，不用再买了。

examples.text: 甲：我的手机修好了吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ de shǒu jī xiū hǎo le ma — Has my phone been fixed?

examples.text: 乙：修好了。现在可以用了。
examples.translation: yǐ xiū hǎo le xiàn zài kě yǐ yòng le — It’s fixed. You can use it now.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: “做完”和“做好”—两种不同的人生: read and discuss the short text below.

examples.text: 每天都忙的你，是不是只知道“做”，只想“做完”，却没有想过“做”的结果？“做完”和“做好”只有一个字不同，但意思却很不一样。后面一个不但做完了工作，而且有一个好的结果。可是，大多数人只知道自己做了很多，不知道自己做得怎么样，也不在乎自己做得怎么样。一个字的不同，后面是不一样的人生。
examples.translation: měi tiān dōu máng de nǐ shì bú shì zhǐ zhī dào zuò zhǐ xiǎng zuò wán què méi yǒu xiǎng guò zuò de jié guǒ zuò wán hé zuò hǎo zhǐ yǒu yí gè zì bù tóng dàn yì si què hěn bù yí yàng hòu miàn yí gè bú dàn zuò wán le gōng zuò ér qiě yǒu yí gè hǎo de jié guǒ kě shì dà duō shù rén zhǐ zhī dào zì jǐ zuò le hěn duō bù zhī dào zì jǐ zuò de zěn me yàng yě bú zài hū zì jǐ zuò de zěn me yàng yí gè zì de bù tóng hòu miàn shì bù yí yàng de rén shēng — You who are busy every day, do you only know how to “do”, only want to “finish”, without ever thinking about the result of the “doing”? “做完” and “做好” differ by only one character, but their meanings are very different. The latter not only finishes the work but also has a good result. Yet most people only know that they have done a lot; they don’t know how well they did and don’t care how well they did. One character’s difference; behind it lies a different life.

options: Completing an action and/or achieving the desired result

exercises.prompt: What does 我已经办好手续了 mean?

exercises.prompt: Which is the negative of 我做完作业了?

exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + complement + object + 了 + 吗.

exercises.prompt: What does 饭菜已经做好了 mean?
What does 我还没有锻炼完 mean?

exercises.explanation: 修好: fixed, so it works.

exercises.prompt: In the essay, what is the difference between 做完 and 做好?
options: 做好 also has a good result

做完功课: finished the homework.

lessons.title: 317. Lesson 13 Presentation 1 grammar: simple directional verbs
lessons.subtitle: 进 出 上 下 回 过 起 · 来 去 · 出了电梯往前走 · 过了安检往左拐

explanations.title: Simple Directional Verbs
explanations.body: The check-in agent tells David: 过了安检，往左拐，坐电梯上二楼，出了电梯往前走，右边第三个登机口就是. In this instruction 过 (“to pass through”), 上 (“to go up”) and 出 (“to go out”) are “simple directional verbs”. Like other transitive verbs they can take objects, but they also indicate directions of movement. There are two types. Type 1: 进, 出, 上, 下, 回, 过, 起; the directions are in reference to locations. Type 2: 来 and 去; the directions are in reference to the speaker: 来 (similar to “come”) means the action is toward the speaker, 去 (similar to “go”) that it is away from the speaker.

examples.text: 我上楼拿东西。
examples.translation: wǒ shàng lóu ná dōng xī — I’m going upstairs to get something.

examples.text: 往前走，过了汽车站就是商店。
examples.translation: wǎng qián zǒu guò le qì chē zhàn jiù shì shāng diàn — Go straight; after you pass the bus station, there is the store.

examples.text: 刚进教室就上课了。
examples.translation: gāng jìn jiào shì jiù shàng kè le — Class began just as I entered the classroom.

examples.text: 下了楼就是机场服务台。
examples.translation: xià le lóu jiù shì jī chǎng fú wù tái — Once you go downstairs, there is the airport service desk.

examples.text: 你每天几点回家。
examples.translation: nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn huí jiā — What time do you go home every day?

examples.text: 周六来我家吃饭。
examples.translation: zhōu liù lái wǒ jiā chī fàn — Come to my house to eat on Saturday.

examples.text: 我们七点去学校。
examples.translation: wǒ men qī diǎn qù xué xiào — We go to school at seven.

explanations.title: Activities 8 and 9
explanations.body: Activity 8 (Reading and Writing). You tell a Chinese friend how to get from the library to the Benihana restaurant. Choose from 进, 出, 上, 下, 回, 过 to complete the directions, using the map as reference (the map is not included; the blanks are empty in the book, so the completed directions are mine, and the book’s gate name Franklin is written 富兰克林).

examples.text: 从图书馆这里去红花饭店，得先下山。你在前面这条路往右拐，然后往前走，出了富兰克林大门，往山下走。过两个红绿灯，在第三个红绿灯往左拐，这时候你在太平街上。往前走，过一个红绿灯，在第二个红绿灯往右拐，然后再往左拐，红花饭店就在你的右边。你得上二楼，才可以进饭店。吃完饭以后回学校，你得上山，有点儿累哦。
examples.translation: cóng tú shū guǎn zhè lǐ qù hóng huā fàn diàn děi xiān xià shān nǐ zài qián miàn zhè tiáo lù wǎng yòu guǎi rán hòu wǎng qián zǒu chū le fù lán kè lín dà mén wǎng shān xià zǒu guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng zuǒ guǎi zhè shí hòu nǐ zài tài píng jiē shàng wǎng qián zǒu guò yí gè hóng lǜ dēng zài dì èr gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi rán hòu zài wǎng zuǒ guǎi hóng huā fàn diàn jiù zài nǐ de yòu biān nǐ děi shàng èr lóu cái kě yǐ jìn fàn diàn chī wán fàn yǐ hòu huí xué xiào nǐ děi shàng shān yǒu diǎnr lèi ó — To get to the Benihana restaurant from the library here, you first have to go down the hill. Turn right on the road in front, then go straight, go out through the Franklin gate and head down the hill. Pass two traffic lights and turn left at the third traffic light; at this point you are on Taiping Street. Go straight, pass one traffic light, turn right at the second traffic light and then left, and the restaurant is on your right. You have to go up to the second floor to be able to enter the restaurant. After the meal, to return to school you have to go up the hill, which is a bit tiring!

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Decide on a starting point and a destination at an airport you have been to, then give your partner simple directions using at least three of 进, 出, 上, 下, 回, 过; exchange roles and repeat. Example: starting point 机场大厅; destination 中国民航 (mínháng, airline) 服务台. B. Pair up. Decide on a place in DLI as the destination and ask your partner to give simple directions using at least three of the directional verbs. The book’s example:

examples.text: 进了机场大厅，坐电梯上三楼，出了电梯往左拐，过三个登机口，就是中国民航服务台，服务台在你的左手边。
examples.translation: jìn le jī chǎng dà tīng zuò diàn tī shàng sān lóu chū le diàn tī wǎng zuǒ guǎi guò sān gè dēng jī kǒu jiù shì zhōng guó mín háng fú wù tái fú wù tái zài nǐ de zuǒ shǒu biān — After you enter the airport hall, take the elevator up to the third floor, turn left after getting out of the elevator, pass three boarding gates, and there is the airline service desk; it’s on your left-hand side.

exercises.prompt: What do the simple directional verbs of Type 1 refer to?
exercises.explanation: 进、出、上、下、回、过、起: in reference to locations.

exercises.prompt: What do 来 and 去 refer to?
exercises.explanation: 来 toward, 去 away from the speaker.

exercises.prompt: What does 下了楼就是机场服务台 mean?
options: The desk is on the roof
Once you go downstairs, there is the airport service desk

exercises.prompt: What does 刚进教室就上课了 mean?
options: Class began just as I entered the classroom

exercises.prompt: Which means “Come to my house to eat on Saturday”?
In 出了电梯往前走, what does 出 mean?
exercises.explanation: 出了电梯: after getting out of the elevator.

exercises.prompt: Which completes: 吃完饭以后___学校? (return to school)
你得上二楼，才可以___饭店。
过两个红绿灯，在第三个红绿灯往左___。

lessons.title: 318. Lesson 13 Presentation 1: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 王先生订票 · 陈丽的旅行 · 机场对话

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking, Writing and Listening): Mr. Wang’s tickets
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Read one paragraph of the story while your partner reads the other. Report what you read to your partner, note the EEIs of your partner’s report, transcribe the critical words and check your dictionary for any words you do not know. B. Discuss with your partner and write your answers: 1. Will the manager be satisfied with Xiao Li’s effort? Why? 2. Why did Xiao Li make the mistake? My reading of the joke (the book gives no answers): Mr. Wang is fat and asked for two tickets, so he needs two seats next to each other; two window seats cannot be side by side, so he will not be satisfied, and the new employee did not understand why his boss wanted two tickets.

examples.text: 王先生是一家电脑公司的经理，常常需要到别的城市出差。有一次，他要去上海出差。因为太忙，所以他让新来公司的小李去买票。王先生很胖，他告诉小李说：“你帮我订两张北京到上海的往返票。要明天一早出发，后天下午五点以后回来的。”
examples.translation: wáng xiān shēng shì yì jiā diàn nǎo gōng sī de jīng lǐ cháng cháng xū yào dào bié de chéng shì chū chāi yǒu yí cì tā yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi yīn wèi tài máng suǒ yǐ tā ràng xīn lái gōng sī de xiǎo lǐ qù mǎi piào wáng xiān shēng hěn pàng tā gào sù xiǎo lǐ shuō nǐ bāng wǒ dìng liǎng zhāng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi de wǎng fǎn piào yào míng tiān yì zǎo chū fā hòu tiān xià wǔ wǔ diǎn yǐ hòu huí lái de — Mr. Wang is a manager at a computer company and often has to go to other cities on business trips. Once, he had to go to Shanghai on business. Because he was too busy, he had Xiao Li, who had just joined the company, buy the ticket. Mr. Wang is fat. He told Xiao Li: “Book me two round-trip tickets from Beijing to Shanghai. They should leave early tomorrow morning and return after five o’clock the day after tomorrow.”

examples.text: 小李很快就在网上订好了票，他高兴地对王经理说：“经理，票已经订好了！明天早上八点十分出发，后天下午五点一刻回来。而且今天运气不错，买到的两张票都是靠窗户的！”
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ hěn kuài jiù zài wǎng shàng dìng hǎo le piào tā gāo xìng dì duì wáng jīng lǐ shuō jīng lǐ piào yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le míng tiān zǎo shàng bā diǎn shí fēn chū fā hòu tiān xià wǔ wǔ diǎn yí kè huí lái ér qiě jīn tiān yùn qì bú cuò mǎi dào de liǎng zhāng piào dōu shì kào chuāng hù de — Xiao Li quickly booked the tickets online and said happily to Manager Wang: “Manager, the tickets are booked! You leave tomorrow morning at 8:10 and return the day after tomorrow at 5:15 in the afternoon. And today we’re lucky; both tickets I bought are window seats!”

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: Pair up. Listen to the two dialogs at the airport check-in desk and answer the questions. Dialog 1: 1. What method did the passenger use to check in? 2. What did the passenger say about his boarding pass? 3. What did the passenger ask of the airline agent? 4. What was said about his luggage? Dialog 2: 1. Where does the passenger want to go? 2. Provide details about the flight. 3. Provide details about the passenger’s luggage. 4. What is his next stop? 5. What directions was he given? B. Using what you heard, mark the statements below true or false; discuss in groups of three, then with the class. (Audio, so no key is given.)

examples.text: 还有两个飞往香港的航班，旅客可以坐上午的，也可以坐下午的。
examples.translation: hái yǒu liǎng gè fēi wǎng xiāng gǎng de háng bān lǚ kè kě yǐ zuò shàng wǔ de yě kě yǐ zuò xià wǔ de — There are two more flights to Hong Kong; the passenger can take the morning one or the afternoon one.

examples.text: 旅客更喜欢靠窗户的座位。
examples.translation: lǚ kè gèng xǐ huān kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi — The passenger prefers a window seat.

examples.text: 旅客不需要托运行李，因为他只有随身带的行李。
examples.translation: lǚ kè bù xū yào tuō yùn xíng li yīn wèi tā zhǐ yǒu suí shēn dài de xíng li — The passenger doesn’t need to check luggage because he only has carry-on luggage.

examples.text: 服务员给了旅客登机牌和行李牌。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán gěi le lǚ kè dēng jī pái hé xíng li pái — The agent gave the passenger a boarding pass and a luggage tag.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and read the passage. Each student then creates three questions in Chinese to ask their partner. The book leaves the questions empty; mine:

examples.text: 陈丽在中国银行工作。因为工作需要，她常常得坐飞机去香港，澳门和新加坡。她都是在网上订机票，然后在网上办理登机手续。这样，到机场以后，就只需要托运行李。每次她带的行李都不多，一个大一点的箱子托运，里面放衣服什么的，小的她就随身带上飞机。她每次都把护照放在随身带的行李箱里。除了护照以外，她还喜欢随身带一本书和一些小吃。她喜欢看飞机外的风景，所以每次都订靠窗户的座位。有时，她也看看书，或是跟旁边的人聊聊天。
examples.translation: chén lì zài zhōng guó yín háng gōng zuò yīn wèi gōng zuò xū yào tā cháng cháng děi zuò fēi jī qù xiāng gǎng ào mén hé xīn jiā pō tā dōu shì zài wǎng shàng dìng jī piào rán hòu zài wǎng shàng bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù zhè yàng dào jī chǎng yǐ hòu jiù zhǐ xū yào tuō yùn xíng li měi cì tā dài de xíng li dōu bù duō yí gè dà yì diǎn de xiāng zi tuō yùn lǐ miàn fàng yī fú shén me de xiǎo de tā jiù suí shēn dài shàng fēi jī tā měi cì dōu bǎ hù zhào fàng zài suí shēn dài de xíng li xiāng lǐ chú le hù zhào yǐ wài tā hái xǐ huān suí shēn dài yì běn shū hé yì xiē xiǎo chī tā xǐ huān kàn fēi jī wài de fēng jǐng suǒ yǐ měi cì dōu dìng kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi yǒu shí tā yě kàn kàn shū huò shì gēn páng biān de rén liáo liáo tiān — Chen Li works at the Bank of China. Because of her work she often has to fly to Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore. She always books air tickets online and then checks in online. This way, after arriving at the airport she only needs to check her luggage. Each time she doesn’t bring much luggage: a somewhat bigger suitcase to check, with clothes and so on inside, and the small one she carries on the plane. She always puts her passport in the carry-on bag. Besides her passport she also likes to carry a book and some snacks. She likes to look at the scenery outside the plane, so she books a window seat every time. Sometimes she also reads a book or chats with the person beside her.

examples.text: 陈丽在哪儿工作？
examples.translation: chén lì zài nǎr gōng zuò — Where does Chen Li work?

examples.text: 她为什么常常坐飞机？
examples.translation: tā wèi shén me cháng cháng zuò fēi jī — Why does she often fly?

examples.text: 她怎么订机票和办理登机手续？
examples.translation: tā zěn me dìng jī piào hé bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù — How does she book tickets and check in?

examples.text: 她为什么每次都订靠窗户的座位？
examples.translation: tā wèi shén me měi cì dōu dìng kào chuāng hù de zuò wèi — Why does she book a window seat every time?

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Listen to two dialogs. Transcribe the critical unknown words and look them up in your dictionary; discuss the problems and solutions with a partner. (Audio, not included.)

明天早上八点十分出发。

exercises.prompt: What did Xiao Li say about the seats?

exercises.prompt: Where does Chen Li often fly?
How does Chen Li check in?
Why does she book a window seat?

exercises.explanation: 她喜欢看飞机外的风景。

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking). Pair up and share your experience of the last time you traveled by air; include 出发时间和城市, 到达时间和城市, 转机, 行李, etc. Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking). Below is flight information from a travel information website in China (prices in yuan; valid dates as printed). Choose one of the American cities as your hometown and use it to find out how to travel to Beijing: what flight would you take and why? In groups of three share your choices and reasons.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to five recordings and write the kind of seat the speakers request and why (Comment 1 to Comment 5: preferred seat; reason). B. In groups of three, list all five comments in your desired order for a window seat, compare and discuss any differences. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking): the e-ticket
explanations.body: Pair up. In Chinese, answer the questions orally using the information on the e-ticket: 1. Is the ticket round trip or one-way? 2. What is the cost? 3. What are the departure city and the destination? 4. What is the flight number? 5. Which airline? 6. What is the flight schedule? The e-ticket (机票信息) reads as in the table, and my answers are in the second table.

rows: 中国东方航空集团公司
tables.title: 机票信息

rows: From Beijing Daxing International Airport to Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport
tables.title: Answers

explanations.title: Activities 5 to 7
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Reading and Speaking). Pair up. Choose one location from the list without revealing it; give your partner directions using the map and location key (you are both at 进口处) and your partner tries to determine the destination. The list: 1. 中餐厅 2. 十号登机口 3. 商场 4. 行李提取处 5. 二十号登机口 6. 卫生间. Useful phrases: 向（右）拐, 往（前）走, 坐电梯（上去）, 出了电梯, 往（左）拐, 在右手边. (The map is a picture, not included.) Activity 6 (Reading and Listening). Listen to the airport announcements (1 to 4) and mark each True or False using the departure information shown. (Audio, not included.) Activity 7 (Reading, Speaking and Listening). A. Create two groups of three; one group travels to 北京, the other to 广州. Decide on a time for your trip, then each group member searches one of the websites 携程网, MoMondo or Expedia and chooses where to buy the ticket. Fill in the table (出发城市 旧金山; 到达城市; 航空公司; 机票价格; 起飞日期和时间; 到达日期和时间; 转机; 回美国日期和时间) and report to your group. B. Compare the information, decide which ticket to book and report your group’s decision to the class.

exercises.prompt: What does 往返 mean in a fare table?
Which airline flies 芝加哥—北京 in the table?
What is the one-way price for 旧金山—北京?
Which route has no one-way fare?
What is the flight number on the e-ticket?
What is the sales price of the e-ticket?
When does the flight take off and land?

units.title: 第十三课 人在机场 Presentation 2: customs, 次, 到…去…, directional verbs

lessons.title: 321. Lesson 13 Presentation 2: entering China (border inspection)
lessons.subtitle: 请出示一下你的护照 · 签证到期 · 你准备在中国呆多长时间？ · 有没有需要报关的物品？

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. Have you ever been to another country? B. What was the purpose of your visit and how long did you stay? C. What documents are needed for travel to foreign countries? D. What questions did the customs officer ask you?

explanations.title: Presentation 2: at border inspection
explanations.body: David goes through entry at the border-inspection counter (the book also prints it in traditional characters). The book writes the amount as 两万人民币.

examples.text: 边检员：您好。请出示一下你的护照。
examples.translation: biān jiǎn yuán nín hǎo qǐng chū shì yí xià nǐ de hù zhào — Hello. Please show me your passport.

examples.text: 大卫：这是我的护照。
examples.translation: dà wèi zhè shì wǒ de hù zhào — Here is my passport.

examples.text: 边检员：你的签证一月到期。现在已经六月了。
examples.translation: biān jiǎn yuán nǐ de qiān zhèng yī yuè dào qī xiàn zài yǐ jīng liù yuè le — Your visa expired in January. It is already June now.

examples.text: 大卫：这页是去年的签证，新的签证在下一页。
examples.translation: dà wèi zhè yè shì qù nián de qiān zhèng xīn de qiān zhèng zài xià yí yè — This page is last year’s visa; the new visa is on the next page.

examples.text: 边检员：哦，看到了。你这次来中国做什么？
examples.translation: biān jiǎn yuán ó kàn dào le nǐ zhè cì lái zhōng guó zuò shén me — Oh, I see it. What are you coming to China for this time?

examples.text: 大卫：我到北京大学参加一个中文培训班。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ dào běi jīng dà xué cān jiā yí gè zhōng wén péi xùn bān — I’m going to Peking University to take part in a Chinese training course.

examples.text: 边检员：你准备在中国呆多长时间？
examples.translation: biān jiǎn yuán nǐ zhǔn bèi zài zhōng guó dāi duō cháng shí jiān — How long do you plan to stay in China?

examples.text: 大卫：培训班三个月，然后我还要到中国各地去旅行，一共差不多六个月。
examples.translation: dà wèi péi xùn bān sān gè yuè rán hòu wǒ hái yào dào zhōng guó gè dì qù lǚ xíng yí gòng chà bu duō liù gè yuè — The course is three months, and then I will also travel around China, about six months altogether.

examples.text: 边检员：你有没有需要报关的物品，比如食品、药品什么的？
examples.translation: biān jiǎn yuán nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xū yào bào guān de wù pǐn bǐ rú shí pǐn yào pǐn shén me de — Do you have any items to declare, such as food, medicine and so on?

examples.text: 大卫：没有，我带的钱也没有超过两万人民币。
examples.translation: dà wèi méi yǒu wǒ dài de qián yě méi yǒu chāo guò liǎng wàn rén mín bì — No, and the money I’m carrying doesn’t exceed 20,000 RMB.

examples.text: 边检员：好。请摘下眼镜，看这儿。好了，你可以入关了。祝你在中国学习愉快！
examples.translation: biān jiǎn yuán hǎo qǐng zhāi xià yǎn jìng kàn zhèr hǎo le nǐ kě yǐ rù guān le zhù nǐ zài zhōng guó xué xí yú kuài — OK. Please take off your glasses and look here. All right, you may enter. Have a good time studying in China!

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening). A. Global listening: where does the conversation take place, and who are the speakers? B. Detailed listening: 1. What problem did the officer find with the passport and what was the traveler’s explanation? 2. How long will the traveler stay and why is he visiting? 3. What concerns does the officer have about his items? 4. What final step must be completed before he is granted entry? (Audio, not included. From the dialog: at the border inspection counter, an officer and David; the visa had expired in January but the new visa is on the next page; six months for a Chinese training course and travel; food and medicine; take off his glasses.) Pair up; your partner plays the customs officer and you the passenger, going through these questions, then switch: 1. May I see your passport please? 2. Where did you fly from? 3. What is your destination? 4. What is the purpose of your visit? 5. How long are you planning to stay? 6. Where will you be staying? 7. Did you bring any food into the country? 8. How much currency are you carrying with you? 9. Do you have anything to declare?

examples.text: 有了一个国家的签证就可以进入这个国家了吗？不，你还需要经过边检和海关。在中国，边检是检查人员的，海关是检查物品的。如果你到中国去，中国边检员会检查你的护照、签证和入境登记卡。如果没有问题，你就可以进入中国。但是，你带的东西还需要经过海关检查。签证有不同的种类，比如旅行签证，商务签证，探亲签证，工作签证和学生签证。不同的签证可以在中国停留的时间也不一样。
examples.translation: yǒu le yí gè guó jiā de qiān zhèng jiù kě yǐ jìn rù zhè ge guó jiā le ma bù nǐ hái xū yào jīng guò biān jiǎn hé hǎi guān zài zhōng guó biān jiǎn shì jiǎn chá rén yuán de hǎi guān shì jiǎn chá wù pǐn de rú guǒ nǐ dào zhōng guó qù zhōng guó biān jiǎn yuán huì jiǎn chá nǐ de hù zhào qiān zhèng hé rù jìng dēng jì kǎ rú guǒ méi yǒu wèn tí nǐ jiù kě yǐ jìn rù zhōng guó dàn shì nǐ dài de dōng xī hái xū yào jīng guò hǎi guān jiǎn chá qiān zhèng yǒu bù tóng de zhǒng lèi bǐ rú lǚ xíng qiān zhèng shāng wù qiān zhèng tàn qīn qiān zhèng gōng zuò qiān zhèng hé xué shēng qiān zhèng bù tóng de qiān zhèng kě yǐ zài zhōng guó tíng liú de shí jiān yě bù yí yàng — Can you enter a country once you have a visa for it? No, you still have to pass border inspection and customs. In China, border inspection checks people and customs checks goods. If you go to China, the Chinese border inspector will check your passport, visa and entry registration card. If there is no problem, you may enter China. But the things you bring still have to pass customs inspection. There are different kinds of visas, such as tourist visas, business visas, family-visit visas, work visas and student visas. Different visas allow different lengths of stay in China.

lessons.title: 322. Lesson 13 Presentation 2 grammar: the action-measure word 次
lessons.subtitle: 去了一次医院 · 看了两次这个电影 · 一周锻炼了几次？

explanations.title: Action-measure word as complement 动量词
explanations.body: Earlier you learned measure words for nouns, like 一盘饺子, 两条领带, 一套公寓. Verbs can also take measure words as complements: the action-measure complement is formed by a numeral and an action-measure word. In this lesson the officer asks David 你这次来中国做什么？; the 次 in this sentence is an action-measure word. Two of the most commonly used are 下 (discussed in Lesson 8; it indicates a short and quick action) and 次, which means the number of times an action occurred. As a complement, the numeral-measure unit comes after the verb. When the verb takes an object, the placement varies: if the object is a noun, it appears after the measure word; if it is a pronoun, it appears before the measure word. Patterns: Verb + Number + Measure Word (+ Noun); Verb + (Pronoun) + Number + Measure Word.

examples.text: 昨天，我去了一次医院。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǒ qù le yí cì yī yuàn — Yesterday I went to the hospital once.

examples.text: 我看了两次这个电影。

examples.text: 你一周锻炼了几次？

lessons.title: 323. Lesson 13 Presentation 2 grammar: the 到…去… construction

explanations.title: 到…去… construction
explanations.body: The 到…去… construction is similar to the English “go to” or “leave for (someplace)” pattern. Subject + 到 + Place + 去 + Verb (+ Obj.). Note: 到 + Place + 去 is equal to 去 + Place; for example 我到图书馆去 = 我去图书馆.

lessons.title: 324. Lesson 13 Presentation 2 grammar: directional verbs after verbs

explanations.title: Simple directional verbs used to indicate direction of action
explanations.body: The directional verbs discussed in Presentation 1 can be put after verbs to indicate the direction of an action. In Presentation 2 the officer asks David 摘下眼镜, “take down your glasses”; here the directional verb 下 is a complement that indicates the direction of 摘. Verb + Directional Verb + Object.

examples.text: 上课前，他走进教室。
examples.translation: shàng kè qián tā zǒu jìn jiào shì — Before class, he walked into the classroom.

examples.text: 下课，他走出教室。
examples.translation: xià kè tā zǒu chū jiào shì — After class, he walked out of the classroom.

examples.text: 中午他跑上山吃饭。
examples.translation: zhōng wǔ tā pǎo shàng shān chī fàn — At noon, he ran up the hill to have lunch.

examples.text: 吃完饭，他走下山。
examples.translation: chī wán fàn tā zǒu xià shān — After lunch, he walked down the hill.

examples.text: 三点，他走回宿舍。
examples.translation: sān diǎn tā zǒu huí sù shè — At 3 p.m., he walked back to his dorm.
