lessons.title: 341. Lesson 14 Presentation 1 grammar: the preposition 离
lessons.subtitle: 这儿离北海公园挺远的 · 离春节很近了 · 离考试还有两天

explanations.title: The preposition 离
explanations.body: The preposition 离 in Chinese indicates the temporal or spatial distance between two points. It is like “from” or “away” in English. Structurally, the two points have to be nouns of place or time in a sentence, and the main predicates often involve an adjective of distance, namely 远 (far) or 近 (near), or the distance or time spent. Patterns: A + 离 + B + 很远/很近/不远/不近…; A + 离 + B + (有/不到) distance; A + 离 + B + (有/不到) time spent. Example from the dialog: 这儿离北海公园挺远的。 (It is pretty far from here to Beihai Park.)

examples.text: 你们家离学校有多远？可以走路去吗？
examples.translation: nǐ men jiā lí xué xiào yǒu duō yuǎn kě yǐ zǒu lù qù ma — How far is your home from school? Can you go on foot?

examples.text: 我们家离学校不远，走路五分钟就到了。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiā lí xué xiào bù yuǎn zǒu lù wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le — Our home is not far from school; it takes five minutes on foot.

examples.text: 蒙特雷离旧金山很远，开车需要两个半小时。
examples.translation: méng tè léi lí jiù jīn shān hěn yuǎn kāi chē xū yào liǎng gè bàn xiǎo shí — Monterey is far from San Francisco; it takes two and a half hours by car.

examples.text: 地铁站离公园大门很近，出了地铁站可以看到公园在马路对面。
examples.translation: dì tiě zhàn lí gōng yuán dà mén hěn jìn chū le dì tiě zhàn kě yǐ kàn dào gōng yuán zài mǎ lù duì miàn — The subway station is very close to the park gate; after leaving the station you can see the park across the road.

examples.text: 现在离春节很近了，所以商店里到处都是人。
examples.translation: xiàn zài lí chūn jié hěn jìn le suǒ yǐ shāng diàn lǐ dào chù dōu shì rén — It is very close to Spring Festival now, so the stores are full of people.

examples.text: 飞机离起飞不到十分钟了，不能打电话了。
examples.translation: fēi jī lí qǐ fēi bú dào shí fēn zhōng le bù néng dǎ diàn huà le — The plane is less than ten minutes from takeoff; you can’t make phone calls now.

examples.text: 现在离考试还有两天，大家都在忙着复习。
examples.translation: xiàn zài lí kǎo shì hái yǒu liǎng tiān dà jiā dōu zài máng zhe fù xí — Now there are two more days until the exam; everybody is busy reviewing.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Work in pairs and practice using 离 with the following words. Each time one student selects one word from the blue card and the other one a word from the green card. Create sentences together using the required pattern and add more information if you can. Blue card: 1. 学校 2. 宿舍 3. 现在 4. 旧金山 5. 我家 6. 公共汽车站 7. 机场 8. 中国饭馆. Green card: a. 电影院 b. 春节 c. 海边 d. 公园 e. 纽约 f. 市中心 g. 图书馆 h. 我的公寓. The book leaves the sentences to you; my sample sentence for each blue-card word:

examples.text: 学校离图书馆很近。
examples.translation: xué xiào lí tú shū guǎn hěn jìn — (mine) The school is very close to the library.

examples.text: 宿舍离海边不远，走路十分钟就到了。
examples.translation: sù shè lí hǎi biān bù yuǎn zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le — (mine) The dorm is not far from the beach; it takes ten minutes on foot.

examples.text: 现在离春节还有两个月。
examples.translation: xiàn zài lí chūn jié hái yǒu liǎng gè yuè — (mine) Now there are two more months until Spring Festival.

examples.text: 旧金山离纽约很远，坐飞机要五个多小时。
examples.translation: jiù jīn shān lí niǔ yuē hěn yuǎn zuò fēi jī yào wǔ gè duō xiǎo shí — (mine) San Francisco is far from New York; it takes over five hours by plane.

examples.text: 我家离公园不远。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā lí gōng yuán bù yuǎn — (mine) My home is not far from the park.

examples.text: 公共汽车站离市中心有三公里。
examples.translation: gōng gòng qì chē zhàn lí shì zhōng xīn yǒu sān gōng lǐ — (mine) The bus stop is three kilometers from downtown.

examples.text: 机场离我的公寓不太远，坐车半个小时。
examples.translation: jī chǎng lí wǒ de gōng yù bú tài yuǎn zuò chē bàn gè xiǎo shí — (mine) The airport is not too far from my apartment; it is half an hour by car.

examples.text: 中国饭馆离我的公寓很近。
examples.translation: zhōng guó fàn guǎn lí wǒ de gōng yù hěn jìn — (mine) The Chinese restaurant is very close to my apartment.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Speaking, Writing and Listening)
explanations.body: A Chinese student is going to start their study at the Middlebury Institute of International Studies at Monterey (MIIS) and would like to know about the school’s location and how far or close it is from local facilities, shopping malls, recreational places and other cities. Create a short video with your phone and provide the information. Your video will be posted on a Chinese social media platform. A. Work in pairs to find the distance from MIIS to all the related places, list the places you would include, and take turns practicing sentences with the 离…很远/很近 pattern. B. Record your video, with you and your partner taking turns describing the location of MIIS and the distances. C. Share your video with the class. (Video, not included.)

options: Distance in space or time between two points

exercises.prompt: What does 蒙特雷离旧金山很远 mean?
options: Monterey is far from San Francisco

exercises.prompt: What does 现在离春节很近了 mean?
options: It is far from Spring Festival
It is very close to Spring Festival now

exercises.prompt: What does 飞机离起飞不到十分钟了 mean?
options: The plane took off ten minutes ago
The plane is less than ten minutes from takeoff
The plane is ten minutes late

exercises.prompt: What does 现在离考试还有两天 mean?
options: The exam is in two weeks
There are two days left until the exam

exercises.prompt: What can follow A + 离 + B?
options: 很远, 很近, or a distance or time spent

exercises.prompt: 我们家离学校不___，走路五分钟就到了。

lessons.title: 342. Lesson 14 Presentation 1 grammar: 从…到…
lessons.subtitle: 从地铁站到北海公园走路只要五分钟 · 从 versus 离

explanations.title: Prepositional Construction 从…到…
explanations.body: In Chinese, the construction 从…到… indicates “from one point to another”, either temporally or spatially. Similar to 离, the two locations must be nouns of place or time. The preposition 从 indicates the starting location or time. Patterns: 从 point A 到 point B + ADJ/V; 从 time A 到 time B + ADJ/V. Example from the dialog: 从地铁站到北海公园走路只要五分钟。 (It only takes five minutes to walk from the subway station to Beihai Park.)

examples.text: 从我的公寓到学校大门，走路十分钟就到了。
examples.translation: cóng wǒ de gōng yù dào xué xiào dà mén zǒu lù shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le — From my apartment to the school gate it takes ten minutes on foot.

examples.text: 请问，从这儿到购物中心有多远？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn cóng zhèr dào gòu wù zhōng xīn yǒu duō yuǎn — Excuse me, how far is it from here to the shopping center?

examples.text: 从第一课到第五课，我们都没有语法问题。
examples.translation: cóng dì yī kè dào dì wǔ kè wǒ men dōu méi yǒu yǔ fǎ wèn tí — From Lesson 1 to Lesson 5, we had no grammar problems.

examples.text: 你们每天从几点到几点上课？
examples.translation: nǐ men měi tiān cóng jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn shàng kè — From what time to what time do you have class every day?

examples.text: 从上海到北京坐火车得需要几个小时？
examples.translation: cóng shàng hǎi dào běi jīng zuò huǒ chē děi xū yào jǐ gè xiǎo shí — How many hours does it take to go from Shanghai to Beijing by train?

explanations.title: The difference between 从 and 离
explanations.body: Note the difference between 从 and 离. 从…到…: 从学校到银行有两英里。 离: 学校离银行有两英里。 从…到…: 从圣诞节 (shèng dàn jié) 到春节还有一个多月。 离: 圣诞节离春节还有一个多月。

examples.text: 从学校到银行有两英里。
examples.translation: cóng xué xiào dào yín háng yǒu liǎng yīng lǐ — From the school to the bank is two miles. (从…到…)

examples.text: 学校离银行有两英里。
examples.translation: xué xiào lí yín háng yǒu liǎng yīng lǐ — The school is two miles from the bank. (离)

examples.text: 从圣诞节到春节还有一个多月。
examples.translation: cóng shèng dàn jié dào chūn jié hái yǒu yí gè duō yuè — From Christmas to Spring Festival is still more than a month. (从…到…)

examples.text: 圣诞节离春节还有一个多月。
examples.translation: shèng dàn jié lí chūn jié hái yǒu yí gè duō yuè — Christmas is more than a month from Spring Festival. (离)

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8
explanations.body: Activity 7 (Writing and Speaking). Complete the sentences using 从…到… and share with a classmate: 1. 上个周末，我和几个朋友一起去海边散步。我们 ___。 2. 以前我的学习很好，___。 3. ___，我得做作业。 4. 现在在北京坐车很方便，___。 5. 这家中国饭馆的菜很好吃，___。 6. ___，只需要三个小时。 My completions (the book leaves them to you; the full sentences are shown):

examples.text: 我们从学校走到海边，走了半个小时。
examples.translation: wǒ men cóng xué xiào zǒu dào hǎi biān zǒu le bàn gè xiǎo shí — (1, mine) We walked from the school to the beach, half an hour.

examples.text: 从小学到高中，我的成绩一直很好。
examples.translation: cóng xiǎo xué dào gāo zhōng wǒ de chéng jì yì zhí hěn hǎo — (2, mine) From elementary school to high school my grades were always good.

examples.text: 从晚上七点到十点，我得做作业。
examples.translation: cóng wǎn shàng qī diǎn dào shí diǎn wǒ děi zuò zuò yè — (3, mine) From seven to ten in the evening, I have to do homework.

examples.text: 从学校到市中心，坐地铁只要二十分钟。
examples.translation: cóng xué xiào dào shì zhōng xīn zuò dì tiě zhǐ yào èr shí fēn zhōng — (4, mine) From school to downtown it takes only twenty minutes by subway.

examples.text: 从北京烤鸭到炒饭，每个菜都不错。
examples.translation: cóng běi jīng kǎo yā dào chǎo fàn měi gè cài dōu bú cuò — (5, mine) From Peking duck to fried rice, every dish is good.

examples.text: 从蒙特雷到旧金山开车，只需要三个小时。
examples.translation: cóng méng tè léi dào jiù jīn shān kāi chē zhǐ xū yào sān gè xiǎo shí — (6, mine) Driving from Monterey to San Francisco only takes three hours.

explanations.title: Activity 8: Weekend plans
explanations.body: Talk about your plans for this weekend using 从…到… and 离. A. Think about where you are going to go and what you are going to do, and make notes. B. Create a short paragraph with six to eight sentences describing your plans using 从…到… and 离. Share with a classmate. My sample paragraph (mine):

examples.text: 这个周末我打算去海边。我家离海边不远，走路十五分钟就到了。星期六早上，从九点到十一点，我要去图书馆做作业。下午我跟朋友一起去海边散步。从海边到中国饭馆走路只要五分钟，我们打算在那儿吃晚饭。星期天我想从早上十点睡到十二点。
examples.translation: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn qù hǎi biān wǒ jiā lí hǎi biān bù yuǎn zǒu lù shí wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le xīng qī liù zǎo shàng cóng jiǔ diǎn dào shí yī diǎn wǒ yào qù tú shū guǎn zuò zuò yè xià wǔ wǒ gēn péng yǒu yì qǐ qù hǎi biān sàn bù cóng hǎi biān dào zhōng guó fàn guǎn zǒu lù zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng wǒ men dǎ suàn zài nàr chī wǎn fàn xīng qī tiān wǒ xiǎng cóng zǎo shàng shí diǎn shuì dào shí èr diǎn — This weekend I plan to go to the beach. My home is not far from the beach; it takes fifteen minutes on foot. Saturday morning, from nine to eleven, I will go to the library to do homework. In the afternoon I will go for a walk at the beach with friends. From the beach to the Chinese restaurant it is only five minutes on foot; we plan to eat dinner there. On Sunday I want to sleep from ten to twelve. (my sample, mine)

options: From one point to another, in space or time
从学校到银行有两英里。
到学校从银行有两英里。

exercises.prompt: Which is the 离 version of 从学校到银行有两英里?
What does 你们每天从几点到几点上课？ ask?
options: From what time to what time class is each day

exercises.prompt: What does 从上海到北京坐火车得需要几个小时？ ask?
options: How much the train ticket costs
How many hours it takes by train from Shanghai to Beijing

exercises.prompt: What does 从第一课到第五课，我们都没有语法问题 mean?
options: From Lesson 1 to 5 we had no grammar problems

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 从…到… correctly?
options: 从我的公寓学校大门，走路十分钟。
从我的公寓到学校大门，走路十分钟就到了。
我的公寓从学校到大门。
exercises.explanation: 从 A 到 B + V.

exercises.prompt: ___地铁站到北海公园走路只要五分钟。
从地铁站___北海公园走路只要五分钟。
你们每天从几点到几点上___？

lessons.title: 343. Lesson 14 Presentation 1: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 天坛公园 · 圆明园 · 潘家园旧货市场

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: Photos: Beijing streets, the Forbidden City, Tiananmen Square, Wangfujing Street. A. Listen to the dialog and mark each statement as True or False (audio, not included, so the key is not given here). B. Pair up, share your work and explain your answers. C. Read the script (the script is not printed in the student version). The seven statements:

examples.text: 王明打算五月二号出去玩。
examples.translation: wáng míng dǎ suàn wǔ yuè èr hào chū qù wán — Wang Ming plans to go out on May 2. (the book prints 五月 2 号 with the digit 2)

examples.text: 大卫在北京一直忙着学习，所以没有好好玩过。
examples.translation: dà wèi zài běi jīng yì zhí máng zhe xué xí suǒ yǐ méi yǒu hǎo hǎo wán guò — David has been busy studying in Beijing, so he hasn’t had a real good time.

examples.text: 王明想去故宫和天安门广场，可是大卫想去王府井。
examples.translation: wáng míng xiǎng qù gù gōng hé tiān ān mén guǎng chǎng kě shì dà wèi xiǎng qù wáng fǔ jǐng — Wang Ming wants to go to the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square, but David wants to go to Wangfujing.

examples.text: 在北京打车比坐公交车快。
examples.translation: zài běi jīng dǎ chē bǐ zuò gōng jiāo chē kuài — In Beijing taking a taxi is faster than taking the bus.

examples.text: 坐公交车可以看风景和街道，还不堵车。
examples.translation: zuò gōng jiāo chē kě yǐ kàn fēng jǐng hé jiē dào hái bù dǔ chē — On the bus you can see scenery and streets and there are no traffic jams.

examples.text: 王明和大卫可以坐二十三路公共汽车，坐五站下车。
examples.translation: wáng míng hé dà wèi kě yǐ zuò èr shí sān lù gōng gòng qì chē zuò wǔ zhàn xià chē — Wang Ming and David can take bus 23 and get off after five stops.

examples.text: 从天安门广场，王明和大卫得坐地铁去故宫。
examples.translation: cóng tiān ān mén guǎng chǎng wáng míng hé dà wèi děi zuò dì tiě qù gù gōng — From Tiananmen Square, Wang Ming and David have to take the subway to the Forbidden City.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and identify the topic of the conversation. B. Listen again and write the essential elements of information (EEIs) in the table: When, Where, Who, What, How. C. Listen once more and answer: 1. Has the first speaker been to the place described by the second speaker? 2. Which route of travel did the second speaker recommend? 3. What could the first speaker and his friends do at the recommended location? List at least two details. 4. How can they get to the second place described in the dialog? D. Share your answers with your partner, then read the script with the class. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. You and your friend are making plans for the coming weekend. The descriptions you found on a travel website of two historic places are below. You read one article and your friend reads the other; each of you writes a summary of the location, including why you would visit it and whether you would recommend it. B. Work in pairs and recite your summaries aloud in Chinese. C. Decide where you will go over the weekend. The book prints numbers as digits (3, 2, 4, 15, 39, 10, 13, 2 and so on); they are spelled out here. The book’s boxes for the summaries are blank; my short summaries follow the passages. 天坛公园:

examples.text: 北京的天坛公园离市中心三公里，公园比较近也比较大，而且还可以坐地铁直达它的东门。从地铁二号线出发，然后转四号线就可直达“天坛公园东门”站。北京地铁怎么坐都是二元。要是你买一张交通卡还能打四折。如果你选择乘坐公交车，你可以看到长安街道路两边的大楼和树木。十五路公交车总站在天桥商场，下车后往东走就是天坛公园的西门。天坛公园非常漂亮，很适合散步和拍照。天坛的颜色特别美：蓝色、绿色的屋顶，红色的墙，白色的栏杆，还有金色的内墙。阳光下这些多彩的颜色真是太美了。因为风景很好，所以拍出来的照片也都很美。天坛东门的对面是一家烤鸭店，很多人去吃，常常需要等位子和桌子。这儿的北京烤鸭，很便宜而且味道也不错，半只鸭子才三十九元，还有一个汤，比别的地方多了一道菜。吃完饭以后，你还可以去附近的咖啡馆喝咖啡，或是去茶馆喝茶。
examples.translation: běi jīng de tiān tán gōng yuán lí shì zhōng xīn sān gōng lǐ gōng yuán bǐ jiào jìn yě bǐ jiào dà ér qiě hái kě yǐ zuò dì tiě zhí dá tā de dōng mén cóng dì tiě èr hào xiàn chū fā rán hòu zhuǎn sì hào xiàn jiù kě zhí dá tiān tán gōng yuán dōng mén zhàn běi jīng dì tiě zěn me zuò dōu shì èr yuán yào shì nǐ mǎi yì zhāng jiāo tōng kǎ hái néng dǎ sì zhé rú guǒ nǐ xuǎn zé chéng zuò gōng jiāo chē nǐ kě yǐ kàn dào cháng ān jiē dào lù liǎng biān de dà lóu hé shù mù shí wǔ lù gōng jiāo chē zǒng zhàn zài tiān qiáo shāng chǎng xià chē hòu wǎng dōng zǒu jiù shì tiān tán gōng yuán de xī mén tiān tán gōng yuán fēi cháng piào liàng hěn shì hé sàn bù hé pāi zhào tiān tán de yán sè tè bié měi lán sè lǜ sè de wū dǐng hóng sè de qiáng bái sè de lán gān hái yǒu jīn sè de nèi qiáng yáng guāng xià zhè xiē duō cǎi de yán sè zhēn shì tài měi le yīn wèi fēng jǐng hěn hǎo suǒ yǐ pāi chū lái de zhào piān yě dōu hěn měi tiān tán dōng mén de duì miàn shì yì jiā kǎo yā diàn hěn duō rén qù chī cháng cháng xū yào děng wèi zi hé zhuō zi zhèr de běi jīng kǎo yā hěn pián yi ér qiě wèi dào yě bú cuò bàn zhī yā zi cái sān shí jiǔ yuán hái yǒu yí gè tāng bǐ bié de dì fāng duō le yí dào cài chī wán fàn yǐ hòu nǐ hái kě yǐ qù fù jìn de kā fēi guǎn hē kā fēi huò shì qù chá guǎn hē chá — The Temple of Heaven Park in Beijing is three kilometers from downtown. The park is fairly close and fairly big, and you can take the subway directly to its east gate. Start from subway Line 2 and then transfer to Line 4 to go directly to “Temple of Heaven East Gate” station. Any subway ride in Beijing costs two yuan. If you buy a transportation card you also get 40% off (the book’s “打4折”, literally four-tenths price). If you choose the bus, you can see the buildings and trees on both sides of Chang’an Avenue. The terminus of bus 15 is at Tianqiao Shopping Mall; after getting off, walk east and you reach the west gate of the park. The Temple of Heaven Park is very beautiful and well suited for strolling and taking pictures. Its colors are especially beautiful: blue and green roofs, red walls, white railings, and golden inner walls. Under the sun these colorful colors are really lovely. Because the scenery is good, the photos you take are all beautiful. Opposite the east gate is a roast duck restaurant; many people eat there and often need to wait for a seat or table. The Peking duck here is cheap and tastes good: half a duck is only thirty-nine yuan, and there is a soup too, one more dish than elsewhere. After eating you can go to a nearby café for coffee or to a teahouse for tea.

examples.text: 天坛公园离市中心不远，可以坐地铁直达，风景很美，适合散步和拍照。门对面的烤鸭店又便宜又好吃。我推荐去天坛公园。
examples.translation: tiān tán gōng yuán lí shì zhōng xīn bù yuǎn kě yǐ zuò dì tiě zhí dá fēng jǐng hěn měi shì hé sàn bù hé pāi zhào mén duì miàn de kǎo yā diàn yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī wǒ tuī jiàn qù tiān tán gōng yuán — Summary (mine): The Temple of Heaven Park is not far from downtown, you can take the subway directly, the scenery is beautiful, and it suits strolling and photos. The roast duck restaurant across the gate is cheap and delicious. I recommend going to the Temple of Heaven Park.

explanations.title: 圆明园
explanations.body: Summary box: Reasons to Visit and Recommendations (mine below).

examples.text: 北京的圆明园被称为“万园之园”。园内水面上种有大片的荷花，夏天的时候，荷花开放，整个园内有看不完的美景。划着游船游玩圆明园也是一种不错的休闲。春秋是游玩圆明园最好的季节，北京的春秋不冷不热，气候适中。暑假的时候，学生很多，天气也比较热。你可以先坐地铁二号线到西直门站，然后换地铁十三号线到“五道口”站，再打车到圆明园。打车只需要十元左右。圆明园的门票只要十元，而且学生还可以半价。从圆明园东门出来，往前走就可以看到清华大学的西门，因为学校很大，可以选择坐校内车看一下校园，坐校内车得花半个小时左右。你也可以租个自行车，花一个小时骑车逛一次清华园。租自行车每个小时十元。另外，你得带上身份证，在学校大门登记后才可以进入。从清华大学出来以后，你可以坐地铁去王府井购物、吃饭、逛街。晚上还可以逛夜市，去酒吧喝酒。
examples.translation: běi jīng de yuán míng yuán bèi chēng wéi wàn yuán zhī yuán yuán nèi shuǐ miàn shàng zhòng yǒu dà piàn de hé huā xià tiān de shí hòu hé huā kāi fàng zhěng gè yuán nèi yǒu kàn bù wán de měi jǐng huà zhe yóu chuán yóu wán yuán míng yuán yě shì yì zhǒng bú cuò de xiū xián chūn qiū shì yóu wán yuán míng yuán zuì hǎo de jì jié běi jīng de chūn qiū bù lěng bú rè qì hòu shì zhōng shǔ jià de shí hòu xué shēng hěn duō tiān qì yě bǐ jiào rè nǐ kě yǐ xiān zuò dì tiě èr hào xiàn dào xī zhí mén zhàn rán hòu huàn dì tiě shí sān hào xiàn dào wǔ dào kǒu zhàn zài dǎ chē dào yuán míng yuán dǎ chē zhǐ xū yào shí yuán zuǒ yòu yuán míng yuán de mén piào zhǐ yào shí yuán ér qiě xué shēng hái kě yǐ bàn jià cóng yuán míng yuán dōng mén chū lái wǎng qián zǒu jiù kě yǐ kàn dào qīng huá dà xué de xī mén yīn wèi xué xiào hěn dà kě yǐ xuǎn zé zuò xiào nèi chē kàn yí xià xiào yuán zuò xiào nèi chē děi huā bàn gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu nǐ yě kě yǐ zū gè zì xíng chē huā yí gè xiǎo shí qí chē guàng yí cì qīng huá yuán zū zì xíng chē měi gè xiǎo shí shí yuán lìng wài nǐ děi dài shàng shēn fèn zhèng zài xué xiào dà mén dēng jì hòu cái kě yǐ jìn rù cóng qīng huá dà xué chū lái yǐ hòu nǐ kě yǐ zuò dì tiě qù wáng fǔ jǐng gòu wù chī fàn guàng jiē wǎn shàng hái kě yǐ guàng yè shì qù jiǔ bā hē jiǔ — Beijing’s Old Summer Palace (Yuanmingyuan) is called the “Garden of Gardens”. Large areas of lotus are planted on the water in the garden; in summer when the lotus flowers bloom, there is endless beautiful scenery throughout the garden. Paddling a pleasure boat around the Old Summer Palace is also a nice way to relax. Spring and autumn are the best seasons to visit; Beijing’s spring and autumn are neither cold nor hot, with a moderate climate. In the summer vacation there are many students and the weather is also rather hot. You can first take subway Line 2 to Xizhimen, then change to Line 13 to “Wudaokou” station, then take a taxi to the Old Summer Palace. A taxi only costs about ten yuan. Admission is only ten yuan, and students get half price. Coming out of the east gate, walk straight ahead and you will see the west gate of Tsinghua University. Because the school is big, you can choose to take the on-campus bus to look at the campus, which takes about half an hour; you can also rent a bicycle and spend an hour touring Tsinghua Garden. Bicycle rental is ten yuan an hour. In addition, you must bring your ID card and register at the school gate before you can enter. After leaving Tsinghua, you can take the subway to Wangfujing for shopping, eating and strolling. At night you can also stroll the night market and have a drink at a bar.

examples.text: 圆明园被称为“万园之园”，春秋最适合去，可以划船看荷花。从圆明园可以走到清华大学，再坐地铁去王府井。我推荐去圆明园。
examples.translation: yuán míng yuán bèi chēng wéi wàn yuán zhī yuán chūn qiū zuì shì hé qù kě yǐ huá chuán kàn hé huā cóng yuán míng yuán kě yǐ zǒu dào qīng huá dà xué zài zuò dì tiě qù wáng fǔ jǐng wǒ tuī jiàn qù yuán míng yuán — Summary (mine): The Old Summer Palace is called the “Garden of Gardens”; spring and autumn are best, you can paddle a boat and see lotus. From it you can walk to Tsinghua University and then take the subway to Wangfujing. I recommend going to the Old Summer Palace.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Read the following advertisement and answer the questions; share your answers. Questions: 1. Who would be interested in this advertisement? 2. What can you buy at this place? 3. How do you get to this location? (Mine: 1. Tourists and people who like antiques, cultural relics, calligraphy and paintings, porcelain or furniture. 2. Cultural relics, calligraphy and paintings, the four treasures of the study, ethnic specialty products, porcelain, wooden furniture. 3. Take bus 34, 674 or 802 to Panjiayuan Bridge West.) B. Find three new words and learn what they mean; write your three words and their English meanings, then share them in groups of three.

examples.text: 潘家园旧货市场规模很大，经营各种文物书画、文房四宝、民族特色产品、瓷器及木器家具等，共有三千多摊位。全国各个省市的商家都在此设摊经营，吸引着大批中外游客。地址：朝阳区东三环潘家园华威里十八号。交通：乘三十四、六百七十四、八百零二路公交车潘家园桥西站下。
examples.translation: pān jiā yuán jiù huò shì chǎng guī mó hěn dà jīng yíng gè zhǒng wén wù shū huà wén fáng sì bǎo mín zú tè sè chǎn pǐn cí qì jí mù qì jiā jù děng gòng yǒu sān qiān duō tān wèi quán guó gè gè shěng shì de shāng jiā dōu zài cǐ shè tān jīng yíng xī yǐn zhe dà pī zhōng wài yóu kè dì zhǐ cháo yáng qū dōng sān huán pān jiā yuán huá wēi lǐ shí bā hào jiāo tōng chéng sān shí sì liù bǎi qī shí sì bā bǎi líng èr lù gōng jiāo chē pān jiā yuán qiáo xī zhàn xià — Panjiayuan Antique Market is very large, dealing in all kinds of cultural relics, calligraphy and paintings, the four treasures of the study, ethnic specialty products, porcelain and wooden furniture, with over three thousand stalls. Merchants from every province and city in the country set up stalls here, attracting large numbers of Chinese and foreign tourists. Address: No. 18 Huaweili, Panjiayuan, East Third Ring Road, Chaoyang District. Transportation: take bus 34, 674 or 802 and get off at Panjiayuan Bridge West stop.

exercises.prompt: How far is the Temple of Heaven Park from downtown?
How do you reach the park by subway?
options: Line 2, then transfer to Line 4 to the East Gate station

exercises.prompt: How much is a subway ride in Beijing?
What discount does a transportation card give?
options: Forty percent off (打四折 in the book)

exercises.prompt: What colors are mentioned at the Temple of Heaven?
options: Blue and green roofs, red walls, white railings, golden inner walls

exercises.prompt: How much is half a roast duck near the east gate?
exercises.explanation: 半只鸭子才三十九元，还有一个汤。

exercises.prompt: Why is the Old Summer Palace called 万园之园?
options: It is known as the “Garden of Gardens”
It is ten thousand years old

exercises.prompt: When is the best time to visit the Old Summer Palace?
exercises.explanation: 春秋是游玩圆明园最好的季节。

exercises.prompt: How much is admission to the Old Summer Palace?
exercises.explanation: 门票只要十元，学生半价。

exercises.prompt: What must you bring to enter Tsinghua University?

options: Cultural relics, calligraphy and paintings, porcelain, furniture

lessons.title: 344. Lesson 14 Presentation 1: using Chinese in context (getting around Beijing)
lessons.subtitle: 打车 · 网约车 · 三轮车 · 公交车 · 地铁 · 骑自行车

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking): scenario
explanations.body: While studying at Beijing University, you and your classmates plan to go to Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City and the Wangfujing Department Store over the weekend (route: 北京大学 to 天安门广场 to 故宫 to 王府井大街). Compare the available modes of transportation, discuss their advantages and disadvantages, decide how you will travel and explain your reasoning. 1. 出租车 (taxi). The book prints the numbers as digits (“10 元/3 公里”); they are spelled out here.

examples.text: 白天，五点到二十三点，起价为三公里十元，超过三公里后，每公里二元；夜间，二十三点到五点，起价为三公里十一元，超过三公里后，每公里二点四元。过路过桥费乘客支付。北京的黑出租很多，不要坐这样的出租车。北京经常堵车，在上下班时，不要打车，乘坐地铁更好。
examples.translation: bái tiān wǔ diǎn dào èr shí sān diǎn qǐ jià wéi sān gōng lǐ shí yuán chāo guò sān gōng lǐ hòu měi gōng lǐ èr yuán yè jiān èr shí sān diǎn dào wǔ diǎn qǐ jià wéi sān gōng lǐ shí yī yuán chāo guò sān gōng lǐ hòu měi gōng lǐ èr diǎn sì yuán guò lù guò qiáo fèi chéng kè zhī fù běi jīng de hēi chū zū hěn duō bú yào zuò zhè yàng de chū zū chē běi jīng jīng cháng dǔ chē zài shàng xià bān shí bú yào dǎ chē chéng zuò dì tiě gèng hǎo — Daytime, 5:00 to 23:00, the base fare is 10 yuan for 3 km, and after 3 km it is 2 yuan per km; at night, 23:00 to 5:00, the base fare is 11 yuan for 3 km, and after 3 km it is 2.4 yuan per km. Road and bridge tolls are paid by the passenger. There are many unlicensed taxis in Beijing; don’t take such taxis. Beijing often has traffic jams; at rush hour don’t take a taxi, taking the subway is better. (Numbers spelled out; the book’s slashes are rewritten.)

explanations.title: 网约车 and 人力三轮车
explanations.body: 2. 网约车 (ride-hailing). The pedicab is described in a separate box.

examples.text: 在北京你也可以随时使用网约车，比如说滴滴出行，只要在手机上下载滴滴出行的打车软件，你就可以非常方便地订车、打车了。滴滴打车的起步价是八元，然后按里程收费，每公里一点五九元。
examples.translation: zài běi jīng nǐ yě kě yǐ suí shí shǐ yòng wǎng yuē chē bǐ rú shuō dī dī chū xíng zhǐ yào zài shǒu jī shàng xià zài dī dī chū xíng de dǎ chē ruǎn jiàn nǐ jiù kě yǐ fēi cháng fāng biàn de dìng chē dǎ chē le dī dī dǎ chē de qǐ bù jià shì bā yuán rán hòu àn lǐ chéng shōu fèi měi gōng lǐ yì diǎn wǔ jiǔ yuán — In Beijing you can also use a ride-hailing app at any time, for example Didi: just download the Didi app on your phone and you can very conveniently book and hail a car. Didi’s base fare is 8 yuan, then it charges by mileage at 1.59 yuan per kilometer.

examples.text: 北京的客运三轮车一般都聚集在市中心和旅游热点等地，每到节假日因为出租车堵车太多，所以人们都去选可以穿过小街道的三轮车。再加上乘三轮车看街景很方便，三轮车的费用常常比出租车高一点。乘坐人力三轮车游老街，大约需要一个半到两个小时，按路线长短收费，一般在三十到一百元左右，可讨价还价，拿到打折的价。人力三轮车也是老北京的特色。
examples.translation: běi jīng de kè yùn sān lún chē yì bān dōu jù jí zài shì zhōng xīn hé lǚ yóu rè diǎn děng dì měi dào jié jià rì yīn wèi chū zū chē dǔ chē tài duō suǒ yǐ rén men dōu qù xuǎn kě yǐ chuān guò xiǎo jiē dào de sān lún chē zài jiā shàng chéng sān lún chē kàn jiē jǐng hěn fāng biàn sān lún chē de fèi yòng cháng cháng bǐ chū zū chē gāo yì diǎn chéng zuò rén lì sān lún chē yóu lǎo jiē dà yuē xū yào yí gè bàn dào liǎng gè xiǎo shí àn lù xiàn cháng duǎn shōu fèi yì bān zài sān shí dào yì bǎi yuán zuǒ yòu kě tǎo jià huán jià ná dào dǎ zhé de jià rén lì sān lún chē yě shì lǎo běi jīng de tè sè — Beijing’s passenger pedicabs generally gather downtown and at tourist hot spots. On every holiday, because there are too many taxi traffic jams, people choose pedicabs, which can pass through small streets. In addition, riding a pedicab makes it convenient to see the street scenes; the cost of a pedicab is often a bit higher than a taxi. Touring the old streets on a pedicab takes about an hour and a half to two hours, charged by the length of the route, generally about 30 to 100 yuan; you can bargain and get a discounted price. The pedicab is also a feature of old Beijing.

explanations.title: 公交车 (buses)
explanations.body: The three kinds of bus described in the book:

examples.text: 公交观光车共有五路，主要去市内各大景点，每条线路各有特色。
examples.translation: gōng jiāo guān guāng chē gòng yǒu wǔ lù zhǔ yào qù shì nèi gè dà jǐng diǎn měi tiáo xiàn lù gè yǒu tè sè — Sightseeing bus lines: there are five routes, mainly going to the major sights in the city; each route has its own character.

examples.text: 这类车去市区和郊区或外省市景点。不包括门票。游客自己买门票，自己进景点游览。每到一个景点，司机会告诉游客回去的时间。
examples.translation: zhè lèi chē qù shì qū hé jiāo qū huò wài shěng shì jǐng diǎn bù bāo kuò mén piào yóu kè zì jǐ mǎi mén piào zì jǐ jìn jǐng diǎn yóu lǎn měi dào yí gè jǐng diǎn sī jī huì gào sù yóu kè huí qù de shí jiān — Tourist special buses: these go to sights in the city, suburbs, or other provinces. Tickets are not included. Tourists buy their own tickets and tour on their own. At each stop the driver tells tourists the time to return.

examples.text: 北京公交车非常多，到市内和郊区各地的都有，还有夜班车、旅游车和专线车等。北京的一些主要街道有公交车专用车道，在堵车时乘坐公交车要比开车和坐出租车方便。市区内公车统一票价一元，郊区公车一元起，路远的加收零点五到一元票价。
examples.translation: běi jīng gōng jiāo chē fēi cháng duō dào shì nèi hé jiāo qū gè dì de dōu yǒu hái yǒu yè bān chē lǚ yóu chē hé zhuān xiàn chē děng běi jīng de yì xiē zhǔ yào jiē dào yǒu gōng jiāo chē zhuān yòng chē dào zài dǔ chē shí chéng zuò gōng jiāo chē yào bǐ kāi chē hé zuò chū zū chē fāng biàn shì qū nèi gōng chē tǒng yí piào jià yì yuán jiāo qū gōng chē yì yuán qǐ lù yuǎn de jiā shōu líng diǎn wǔ dào yì yuán piào jià — Ordinary buses: Beijing has very many buses, going everywhere in the city and suburbs, with night buses, tourist buses and special lines. Some main streets have bus-only lanes, so in a traffic jam taking a bus is more convenient than driving or taking a taxi. Within the city the fare is a flat 1 yuan, suburban buses start at 1 yuan, and long routes add 0.5 to 1 yuan.

explanations.title: 地铁 (subway) and 骑自行车 (bicycle)
explanations.body: The book also shows the subway website and the lines’ main stops: line 1: 军事博物馆、西单、天安门、王府井、国贸; line 2: 西直门、宣武门、前门、北京站、雍和宫、鼓楼大街、积水潭; line 4: 黄村火车站、北京南站、陶然亭、宣武门、西单、国家图书馆、中关村、北京大学、圆明园. Some bicycle rental points are listed below.

examples.text: 北京地铁线路包括一号线、二号线、四号线、五号线、八号线、十号线、十三号线等等。北京地铁票价统一为二元，机场快线除外，票价二十五元，想坐多少次，想坐多远都可以。地铁一、二号线穿过北京老城和市内众多景点与商业中心；八号线直接进入奥运中心；四号线在景点、大学、购物的地方停靠。
examples.translation: běi jīng dì tiě xiàn lù bāo kuò yī hào xiàn èr hào xiàn sì hào xiàn wǔ hào xiàn bā hào xiàn shí hào xiàn shí sān hào xiàn děng děng běi jīng dì tiě piào jià tǒng yì wéi èr yuán jī chǎng kuài xiàn chú wài piào jià èr shí wǔ yuán xiǎng zuò duō shǎo cì xiǎng zuò duō yuǎn dōu kě yǐ dì tiě yī èr hào xiàn chuān guò běi jīng lǎo chéng hé shì nèi zhòng duō jǐng diǎn yǔ shāng yè zhōng xīn bā hào xiàn zhí jiē jìn rù ào yùn zhōng xīn sì hào xiàn zài jǐng diǎn dà xué gòu wù de dì fāng tíng kào — Beijing subway lines include lines 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 13 and so on. The Beijing subway fare is a flat 2 yuan (the Airport Express excepted, fare 25 yuan); you can ride as many times and as far as you like. Lines 1 and 2 pass through the old city and many sights and commercial centers; Line 8 goes directly into the Olympic Center; Line 4 stops at sights, universities and shopping areas.

examples.text: 骑自行车，可以休闲地从一个景点骑到另一个景点，游览北京的老街。北京有公共自行车出租点，主要在地铁和商业区等地方。在北京的许多大饭店也有出租自行车的服务，日租金在二十到三十元左右。
examples.translation: qí zì xíng chē kě yǐ xiū xián de cóng yí gè jǐng diǎn qí dào lìng yí gè jǐng diǎn yóu lǎn běi jīng de lǎo jiē běi jīng yǒu gōng gòng zì xíng chē chū zū diǎn zhǔ yào zài dì tiě hé shāng yè qū děng dì fāng zài běi jīng de xǔ duō dà fàn diàn yě yǒu chū zū zì xíng chē de fú wù rì zū jīn zài èr shí dào sān shí yuán zuǒ yòu — Riding a bicycle, you can leisurely ride from one sight to another and tour Beijing’s old streets. Beijing has public bicycle rental points, mainly at subways and commercial areas. Many big hotels in Beijing also rent bicycles; the daily rental is about 20 to 30 yuan.

examples.text: 什刹海附近，单人车每小时十元，双人车每小时二十元，押金五百元。
examples.translation: shén shā hǎi fù jìn dān rén chē měi xiǎo shí shí yuán shuāng rén chē měi xiǎo shí èr shí yuán yā jīn wǔ bǎi yuán — Near Shichahai: single bike 10 yuan an hour, tandem 20 yuan an hour, deposit 500 yuan.

examples.text: 侣松园宾馆对面，单人车每小时五元，双人车每小时十元，押金三百元。

explanations.title: Activity 1 (continued)
explanations.body: A. Work in pairs. Read the information about the mode of transportation given to you by your teacher; take notes on its advantages and disadvantages in Chinese characters or pinyin (table: Mode of Transportation, Advantages, Disadvantages); search online for more if needed. B. Work in groups of three. Students from each pair recommend the mode they studied; your partners ask for its advantages and disadvantages; complete the table (rows: 公交车, 地铁, 打车：出租车, 滴滴打车, 其它：骑自行车, 人力三轮车). C. Return to your pairs and decide which mode you will use; you can combine modes. D. Present your decisions and choices to the class.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking, Listening, and Writing): Mini Project, A Weekend Plan
explanations.body: After your first two weeks of study at Qinghua University in Beijing, you and your friends decide to explore the region. You need to create a weekend plan and present it to your class; the class will vote on which plan they prefer. A. Work in groups of three. Each group selects one of the maps and circles the locations they would like to visit. Map 1: 香山, 圆明园, 颐和园. Map 2: 慕田峪长城, 八达岭长城 (photographs not included). B. Each group watches a video about an interesting location on its map (video 1 for map 1: Summer Palace; video 2 for map 2: Mutianyu Great Wall, first three minutes), takes notes and discusses whether to recommend it. (Videos, not included.) C. After the video, study your map again; decide whether you would like to visit other places on it. Create a weekend plan together on a white board or flip chart, in Chinese characters: where you will go, the activities, the types of transportation, travel durations and schedules. D. Present your plan to the class; the class votes.

lessons.title: 347. Lesson 14 Presentation 2: a trip to Xi’an
lessons.subtitle: 你怎么不参加旅行团呢？ · 自己去，多自由呀 · 那倒也是

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. What famous historical sites have you visited? Where are they? B. When you travel, do you prefer traveling alone or in a group? Why? C. What is your next travel plan? Share your destination, tentative time, mode of transportation, etc.

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 去西安
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters. Notes: 像. 像 is used to compare a specific characteristic between two things or people. It means “just like.” 倒. 倒 is used to concede a point or admit you were wrong. 那倒也是 means “I guess so; I hadn’t thought of it like that before.”

examples.text: 大卫：暑假快到了，你有什么打算吗？
examples.translation: dà wèi shǔ jià kuài dào le nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn ma — Summer vacation is coming; do you have any plans?

examples.text: 马克：有啊。我打算和几个朋友一起开车去西安看看。
examples.translation: mǎ kè yǒu a wǒ dǎ suàn hé jǐ gè péng yǒu yì qǐ kāi chē qù xī ān kàn kàn — Yes. I plan to drive to Xi’an with a few friends to have a look.

examples.text: 大卫：为什么去那儿呢？
examples.translation: dà wèi wèi shén me qù nàr ne — Why go there?

examples.text: 马克：西安是中国有名的古都，到处都是名胜古迹。
examples.translation: mǎ kè xī ān shì zhōng guó yǒu míng de gǔ dū dào chù dōu shì míng shèng gǔ jì — Xi’an is a famous ancient capital of China; there are scenic spots and historical sites everywhere.

examples.text: 大卫：比如说……
examples.translation: dà wèi bǐ rú shuō — For example…

examples.text: 马克：比如兵马俑，大雁塔什么的，都非常值得一看。
examples.translation: mǎ kè bǐ rú bīng mǎ yǒng dà yàn tǎ shén me de dōu fēi cháng zhí de yí kàn — For example the Terracotta Army, the Big Wild Goose Pagoda and so on; all are well worth seeing.

examples.text: 大卫：从北京开车到西安，大概需要多长时间？
examples.translation: dà wèi cóng běi jīng kāi chē dào xī ān dà gài xū yào duō cháng shí jiān — Driving from Beijing to Xi’an, about how long does it take?

examples.text: 马克：十二三个小时吧。
examples.translation: mǎ kè shí èr sān gè xiǎo shí ba — Twelve or thirteen hours, I’d say.

examples.text: 大卫：你怎么不参加旅行团呢？
examples.translation: dà wèi nǐ zěn me bù cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán ne — Why not join a tour group?

examples.text: 马克：参加旅行团有什么没意思啊。大家都去一样的地方，照一样的照片。
examples.translation: mǎ kè cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán yǒu shén me méi yì si a dà jiā dōu qù yí yàng de dì fāng zhào yí yàng de zhào piān — What’s the fun in joining a tour group? Everyone goes to the same places and takes the same photos. (The traditional-character version prints 有什么意思啊, “what’s the fun”.)

examples.text: 大卫：那，你觉得怎么去好？
examples.translation: dà wèi nà nǐ jué de zěn me qù hǎo — Then, how do you think is best to go?

examples.text: 马克：自己去。你可以选喜欢的路线，还可以住民宿，和当地人聊天，多自由呀。
examples.translation: mǎ kè zì jǐ qù nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn xǐ huān de lù xiàn hái kě yǐ zhù mín sù hé dāng dì rén liáo tiān duō zì yóu ya — Go on your own. You can choose the route you like, stay in a home stay and chat with locals; how free that is!

examples.text: 大卫：可是，自己做旅行计划太麻烦了。像我这样的懒人还是参加旅行团比较方便！
examples.translation: dà wèi kě shì zì jǐ zuò lǚ xíng jì huà tài má fán le xiàng wǒ zhè yàng de lǎn rén hái shì cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán bǐ jiào fāng biàn — But making your own travel plans is too troublesome. For a lazy person like me, joining a tour group is more convenient!

examples.text: 马克：那倒也是。导游帮你订旅馆、买门票，你什么事都不用做，只要跟着导游走就行了。
examples.translation: mǎ kè nà dào yě shì dǎo yóu bāng nǐ dìng lǚ guǎn mǎi mén piào nǐ shén me shì dōu bú yòng zuò zhǐ yào gēn zhe dǎo yóu zǒu jiù xíng le — That’s true. The guide books hotels and buys tickets for you; you don’t need to do anything, just follow the guide.

examples.text: 大卫：我就是这么想的。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ jiù shì zhè me xiǎng de — That’s just what I was thinking.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking). A. Global listening: 1. What would be an appropriate title for this presentation? 2. What does each speaker prefer? B. Detail listening: 1. What is the second speaker’s plan? Why does the speaker plan to do that? 2. What is the first speaker’s suggestion? Does the second speaker like the idea? Why? 3. List three advantages of the second speaker’s preferences. 4. What are the advantages of the first speaker’s preferences? (Audio, not included. From the text: Mark plans to drive to Xi’an because it is an ancient capital full of sights; Mark prefers traveling on his own for freedom, routes and local contact; David prefers a tour group because it is convenient.) Activity 2 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening). A. Before traveling you need a travel plan. Consider all the aspects and write the details in the diagram in Chinese characters: 旅行计划 with 目的地, 交通, 住宿, 时间, 旅行方式, 活动. B. Share your diagram with a classmate. C. Your teacher will check the characters. (The book leaves the diagram blank.)

lessons.title: 348. Lesson 14 Presentation 2 activities: matching and the Zhengzhou conversation
lessons.subtitle: 高铁去郑州 · 少林寺 · 龙门石窟 · 跟团游还是自由行

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Match each question with its most likely answer. The questions: 1. 周末快到了，你有什么打算？ 2. 北京有什么名胜古迹？ 3. 从南京坐高铁到上海大概需要多长时间？ 4. 你怎么不参加旅行团？ 5. 你觉得怎么住好？ The answers: a. 天安门，故宫，长城什么的。 b. 只要一个小时。 c. 民宿呀，可以和当地人聊天。 d. 我计划开车去旧金山。 e. 那么多人去同样的地方，没意思。 My matching (mine): 1-d, 2-a, 3-b, 4-e, 5-c.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog once and choose the best answer: 1. What is the relationship between the two speakers? (Student and teacher / Two teachers / Father and son / Two students) 2. What is the topic of this dialog? (Travel plans during Spring Festival / Transportation in Taiwan and China / Scenery on the outskirts of Taipei / Services provided by a travel agency) B. Listen again and decide whether each statement is true or false; in groups of three discuss your answers: 1. The second speaker plans to travel to Taipei, Taizhong and Taidong. 2. The second speaker plans to go to Chinatown in San Francisco and dine with their parents. 3. The second speaker is going on a long-distance bus ride and a high-speed train ride. 4. The second speaker has booked their flight tickets and train tickets. 5. The first speaker’s family plans to travel together next summer. 6. The first speaker gave the second speaker a website address. (Audio, not included, so no key.)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening): Students 1, 2 and 3
explanations.body: A. Work in groups of three. Each student reads one part of a conversation between two friends (Student 1: the first seven lines up to 云台山; Student 2: from 从北京坐高铁到郑州 to the “年纪大的人喜欢的” line; Student 3: from 那，你觉得怎么旅游最好呢？ to the end) and summarizes it in their own words. B. Share your summary with your group. C. Complete the table with the information from each other. D. Pair up with a new partner and read the complete conversation aloud; compare the preferences of the two speakers. The complete conversation:

examples.text: 林东：大卫，还有两个星期暑假就到了，你有什么打算吗？
examples.translation: lín dōng dà wèi hái yǒu liǎng gè xīng qī shǔ jià jiù dào le nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn ma — David, summer vacation is only two weeks away; do you have any plans?

examples.text: 大卫：有啊。我跟几个美国来的朋友打算一起坐高铁去郑州玩玩。
examples.translation: dà wèi yǒu a wǒ gēn jǐ gè měi guó lái de péng yǒu dǎ suàn yì qǐ zuò gāo tiě qù zhèng zhōu wán wán — Yes. A few friends from America and I plan to take the high-speed train to Zhengzhou.

examples.text: 林东：你们为什么想要去那儿呢？
examples.translation: lín dōng nǐ men wèi shén me xiǎng yào qù nàr ne — Why do you want to go there?

examples.text: 大卫：我们都喜欢中国的功夫电影，想到少林寺去看看。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ men dōu xǐ huān zhōng guó de gōng fu diàn yǐng xiǎng dào shào lín sì qù kàn kàn — We all like Chinese kung fu movies and want to see the Shaolin Temple.

examples.text: 林东：好主意。郑州跟西安一样，也是有名的古都。你们还可以去看看别的名胜古迹。
examples.translation: lín dōng hǎo zhǔ yì zhèng zhōu gēn xī ān yí yàng yě shì yǒu míng de gǔ dū nǐ men hái kě yǐ qù kàn kàn bié de míng shèng gǔ jì — Good idea. Zhengzhou, like Xi’an, is also a famous ancient capital. You can also see other sights.

examples.text: 大卫：比如说……
examples.translation: dà wèi bǐ rú shuō — For example…

examples.text: 林东：比如说，龙门石窟、云台山什么的，都非常值得一看。
examples.translation: lín dōng bǐ rú shuō lóng mén shí kū yún tái shān shén me de dōu fēi cháng zhí de yí kàn — For example the Longmen Grottoes, Yuntai Mountain and so on are all well worth a look.

examples.text: 大卫：从北京坐高铁到郑州，大概需要多长时间？
examples.translation: dà wèi cóng běi jīng zuò gāo tiě dào zhèng zhōu dà gài xū yào duō cháng shí jiān — How long does it take by high-speed train from Beijing to Zhengzhou?

examples.text: 林东：最快的大概两个半小时就到了。
examples.translation: lín dōng zuì kuài de dà gài liǎng gè bàn xiǎo shí jiù dào le — The fastest takes about two and a half hours.

examples.text: 大卫：那么快啊，太好了。对了，我怎么订旅馆最好？
examples.translation: dà wèi nà me kuài a tài hǎo le duì le wǒ zěn me dìng lǚ guǎn zuì hǎo — That fast? Great. By the way, what’s the best way to book a hotel?

examples.text: 林东：你要自己订旅馆啊？多麻烦啊！怎么不参加旅行团呢？导游可以帮你们订旅馆、买门票，你自己呢什么事都不用做，只要跟着导游走就好了。
examples.translation: lín dōng nǐ yào zì jǐ dìng lǚ guǎn a duō má fán a zěn me bù cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán ne dǎo yóu kě yǐ bāng nǐ men dìng lǚ guǎn mǎi mén piào nǐ zì jǐ ne shén me shì dōu bú yòng zuò zhǐ yào gēn zhe dǎo yóu zǒu jiù hǎo le — You want to book hotels yourself? How troublesome! Why not join a tour group? The guide can book hotels and buy tickets for you; you don’t have to do anything, just follow the guide.

examples.text: 大卫：参加旅行团有什么意思啊，大家去的地方一样，连照的照片都一样。而且那是年纪大的人喜欢的。
examples.translation: dà wèi cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán yǒu shén me yì si a dà jiā qù de dì fāng yí yàng lián zhào de zhào piān dōu yí yàng ér qiě nà shì nián jì dà de rén xǐ huān de — What’s the fun in a tour group? Everyone goes to the same places, even the photos are the same. Besides, that’s what older people like.

examples.text: 林东：那，你觉得怎么旅游最好呢？
examples.translation: lín dōng nà nǐ jué de zěn me lǚ yóu zuì hǎo ne — Then how do you think is the best way to travel?

examples.text: 大卫：自己去，我和我的朋友们都特别喜欢自由行。不仅可以选自己喜欢的路线，还可以住民宿，和当地人聊天、吃当地的饭，多有意思啊。
examples.translation: dà wèi zì jǐ qù wǒ hé wǒ de péng yǒu men dōu tè bié xǐ huān zì yóu xíng bù jǐn kě yǐ xuǎn zì jǐ xǐ huān de lù xiàn hái kě yǐ zhù mín sù hé dāng dì rén liáo tiān chī dāng dì de fàn duō yǒu yì si a — Go on my own; my friends and I all especially like independent travel. Not only can we choose our own route, we can also stay in a home stay, chat with locals and eat local food. How interesting!

examples.text: 林东：可是，自己做旅行计划，订旅馆，买火车票，这也太麻烦了，不适合我这样的懒人。我还是喜欢旅行团。
examples.translation: lín dōng kě shì zì jǐ zuò lǚ xíng jì huà dìng lǚ guǎn mǎi huǒ chē piào zhè yě tài má fán le bú shì hé wǒ zhè yàng de lǎn rén wǒ hái shì xǐ huān lǚ xíng tuán — But making your own travel plans, booking hotels, buying train tickets, is too troublesome and doesn’t suit a lazy person like me. I still prefer tour groups.

examples.text: 大卫：那倒也是。你是挺懒的！哈哈，我开玩笑呢。
examples.translation: dà wèi nà dào yě shì nǐ shì tǐng lǎn de hā hā wǒ kāi wán xiào ne — That’s true. You are quite lazy! Ha ha, I’m joking.

Why do they want to go to Zhengzhou?
options: They like kung fu movies and want to see the Shaolin Temple
exercises.explanation: 喜欢中国的功夫电影，想到少林寺去看看。

exercises.prompt: How long does the fastest train from Beijing to Zhengzhou take?
options: About two and a half hours
exercises.explanation: 最快的大概两个半小时。

exercises.prompt: What does Lin Dong think of independent travel?
options: He has never heard of it
Too troublesome; he prefers a tour group

exercises.prompt: What does David think of tour groups?
options: Boring, the photos are all the same, and for older people
exercises.explanation: 参加旅行团有什么意思啊。

exercises.prompt: What is Lin Dong accused of?
exercises.explanation: 你是挺懒的！我开玩笑呢。

exercises.prompt: 我跟几个美国来的朋友打算一起坐高___去郑州玩玩。
郑州跟西安一样，也是有名的古___。

lessons.title: 349. Lesson 14 Presentation 2 grammar: 什么 + 吗
lessons.subtitle: 你有什么打算吗？ · 您买什么吗？ · 什么 + 吗 softens the question

explanations.title: 什么 + 吗
explanations.body: In Chinese, when a question word 什么 is used in a sentence together with 吗, the sentence is not asking for the information that the question word indicates any more, but rather the information that the main verb indicates. In practice, “什么 + 吗” softens the tone of asking. Compare 暑假快到了，你有打算吗？ and 暑假快到了，你有什么打算吗？ The second one sounds softer in tone and more polite.

examples.text: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算吗？
examples.translation: shǔ jià kuài dào le nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn ma — Summer vacation is around the corner. Do you have a plan or not? (the speaker does not know if “you” have a plan)

examples.text: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算？
examples.translation: shǔ jià kuài dào le nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn — Summer vacation is around the corner. What’s your plan? (the speaker is certain “you” have a plan but wants to know what kind)

examples.text: 暑假快到了，你有打算吗？
examples.translation: shǔ jià kuài dào le nǐ yǒu dǎ suàn ma — Summer vacation is around the corner; do you have a plan? (plain)

examples.text: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算吗？
examples.translation: shǔ jià kuài dào le nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn ma — (the same, with 什么 + 吗: softer and more polite)

explanations.title: Examples
explanations.body: Examples with and without 什么: 1. 你有什么打算吗？ vs. 你有打算吗？ 2. 您买什么吗？ vs. 您买什么？ 3. 你有什么想法吗？ vs. 你有什么想法？

examples.text: 你有什么打算吗？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn ma — Do you have any plan? (softer; vs. 你有打算吗？)

examples.text: 你有打算吗？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu dǎ suàn ma — Do you have a plan? (plain yes/no question)

examples.text: 您买什么吗？
examples.translation: nín mǎi shén me ma — Are you buying anything? (vs. 您买什么？ What are you buying?)

examples.text: 您买什么？
examples.translation: nín mǎi shén me — What are you buying?

examples.text: 你有什么想法吗？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu shén me xiǎng fǎ ma — Do you have any ideas? (softer; vs. 你有什么想法？ What are your ideas?)

examples.text: 你有什么想法？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu shén me xiǎng fǎ — What are your ideas?

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Writing, Speaking and Listening). A. Work in groups of three. Each student writes two sentences in Chinese: one a regular 什么 question and the other a 什么 + 吗 question; think about the meaning of your sentences. B. Share your sentences with your two partners and compare their meanings. My samples:

examples.text: 你想吃什么吗？
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me ma — (mine) Is there anything you’d like to eat? (soft offer)

examples.text: 你想吃什么？
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me — (mine) What do you want to eat?

examples.text: 你最近有什么事吗？
examples.translation: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu shén me shì ma — (mine) Is something going on with you lately?

examples.text: 你最近有什么事？
examples.translation: nǐ zuì jìn yǒu shén me shì — (mine) What is going on with you lately?

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the three sentences and write the English translation of each in the table; share your answers with a classmate. B. Work in pairs and take turns answering the questions you just heard in Chinese. C. Read the scripts if needed. (Audio, not included.)

exercises.prompt: What does 什么 + 吗 do?
options: Asks about the verb’s information and softens the tone

exercises.prompt: Which is the softer, more polite version?
What does 你有什么打算？ expect?
options: A description of the plan (the speaker is sure there is one)

exercises.prompt: What does 你有什么打算吗？ ask?
options: Whether you have a plan at all

exercises.prompt: What does 您买什么吗？ ask?
What does 你有什么想法吗？ ask?
What does 什么 stop meaning in 什么 + 吗?
options: “What” as a request for specific information
exercises.explanation: No longer asking for the thing.

exercises.prompt: 暑假快到了，你有什么打算___？

lessons.title: 350. Lesson 14 Presentation 2 grammar: the rhetorical question with 什么
lessons.subtitle: 有什么意思啊？ · 去什么体育馆呀？ · 还有什么自由呢？

explanations.title: The Rhetorical Question with 什么 (+ Object) + 啊/呢/呀?
explanations.body: A rhetorical question is asked without expecting a direct answer—when the speaker already has an opinion on the topic and doesn’t expect an answer. In Chinese, adding 啊 after 什么 (noun) can change a question sentence into a rhetorical question. This usage is usually followed or preceded by a clause that states the reasons. These kinds of rhetorical questions are more likely to occur between friends, or two people who are familiar with each other. Pattern: Verb + 什么 (+ Object) + 啊/呢/呀？

examples.text: 参加旅行团有什么意思啊？大家都去一样的地方，照一样的照片。
examples.translation: cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán yǒu shén me yì si a dà jiā dōu qù yí yàng de dì fāng zhào yí yàng de zhào piān — What is the fun in joining a tour? Everyone goes to the same place and takes the same pictures. (There is no fun in joining a tour.)

examples.text: 今天是星期五，去什么体育馆呀？
examples.translation: jīn tiān shì xīng qī wǔ qù shén me tǐ yù guǎn ya — Today is Friday; why would we go to the gym? (We should not have to go to the gym on Friday.)

explanations.title: Examples
explanations.body: Examples 1 to 5:

examples.text: 你开什么玩笑啊？你打了我，还要我跟你说“对不起”？
examples.translation: nǐ kāi shén me wán xiào a nǐ dǎ le wǒ hái yào wǒ gēn nǐ shuō duì bù qǐ — What kind of joke is this? You hit me, and you still want me to say “sorry” to you?

examples.text: 你没钱，请我吃什么饭啊？
examples.translation: nǐ méi qián qǐng wǒ chī shén me fàn a — You have no money; what are you inviting me to dinner for?

examples.text: 还看什么电影啊？要考试了，得复习功课。
examples.translation: hái kàn shén me diàn yǐng a yào kǎo shì le děi fù xí gōng kè — Why watch a movie? There’s an exam coming; we have to review.

examples.text: 今天是星期五，去什么体育馆呀？
examples.translation: jīn tiān shì xīng qī wǔ qù shén me tǐ yù guǎn ya — It’s Friday, why go to the gym?

examples.text: 如果你都不可以说自己想说的话，还有什么自由呢？
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ dōu bù kě yǐ shuō zì jǐ xiǎng shuō de huà hái yǒu shén me zì yóu ne — If you can’t even say what you want to say, what freedom is there?

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Work in pairs. Take turns picking one Chinese word from the list (睡觉, 去图书馆, 学中文, 聊天, 兑换人民币, 上网, 买新皮鞋, 付现金, 做饭, 坐公共汽车) and using it to create a rhetorical question with 什么. Share your questions with the class. My sample for each word (mine):

examples.text: 还睡什么觉啊？天都亮了，快起床！
examples.translation: hái shuì shén me jiào a tiān dōu liàng le kuài qǐ chuáng — Why still sleep? It’s already light; get up!

examples.text: 去什么图书馆啊？图书馆今天不开门。
examples.translation: qù shén me tú shū guǎn a tú shū guǎn jīn tiān bù kāi mén — Why go to the library? It isn’t open today.

examples.text: 学什么中文啊？这么难，我不学了！
examples.translation: xué shén me zhōng wén a zhè me nán wǒ bù xué le — Why study Chinese? It’s so hard, I quit!

examples.text: 聊什么天啊？明天就考试了。
examples.translation: liáo shén me tiān a míng tiān jiù kǎo shì le — Why chat? The exam is tomorrow.

examples.text: 兑换什么人民币啊？这儿可以用手机付钱。
examples.translation: duì huàn shén me rén mín bì a zhèr kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù qián — Why exchange RMB? You can pay with a phone here.

examples.text: 上什么网啊？网络坏了。
examples.translation: shàng shén me wǎng a wǎng luò huài le — Why go online? The network is down.

examples.text: 买什么新皮鞋啊？你有那么多双。
examples.translation: mǎi shén me xīn pí xié a nǐ yǒu nà me duō shuāng — Why buy new leather shoes? You have so many pairs.

examples.text: 付什么现金啊？可以刷卡。
examples.translation: fù shén me xiàn jīn a kě yǐ shuā kǎ — Why pay cash? You can use a card.

examples.text: 做什么饭啊？我们去饭馆吃吧。
examples.translation: zuò shén me fàn a wǒ men qù fàn guǎn chī ba — Why cook? Let’s eat out.

examples.text: 坐什么公共汽车啊？这么堵，走路更快。
examples.translation: zuò shén me gōng gòng qì chē a zhè me dǔ zǒu lù gèng kuài — Why take the bus? With this jam, walking is faster.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Speaking, Writing and Listening): Good and Bad Arguments
explanations.body: A. Work in pairs. Choose one of the scenarios (an argument between husband and wife; an argument between two friends; a disagreement between a customer and a salesperson; a disagreement between two colleagues) and write a dialog expressing an argument between two people, using rhetorical questions with 什么 in as many different ways as you can. B. Share your work with the class by acting out your dialog. My sample, husband and wife (mine):

examples.text: 丈夫：你买什么买啊？家里的衣服已经够多了！
examples.translation: zhàng fū nǐ mǎi shén me mǎi a jiā lǐ de yī fú yǐ jīng gòu duō le — What are you buying for? We already have enough clothes at home!

examples.text: 妻子：你说什么呢？这件衣服才打五折！
examples.translation: qī zǐ nǐ shuō shén me ne zhè jiàn yī fú cái dǎ wǔ zhé — What are you saying? This piece is only half price!

examples.text: 丈夫：打五折也是钱啊，还买什么买呢？
examples.translation: zhàng fū dǎ wǔ zhé yě shì qián a hái mǎi shén me mǎi ne — Half price is still money. Why buy it?

examples.text: 妻子：好了好了，我不买了。你生什么气啊！
examples.translation: qī zǐ hǎo le hǎo le wǒ bù mǎi le nǐ shēng shén me qì a — OK OK, I won’t buy it. What are you getting angry for!

options: A question asked without expecting an answer

exercises.prompt: What does 参加旅行团有什么意思啊？ really mean?
options: There is no fun in joining a tour
Joining a tour is very fun

exercises.prompt: What does 去什么体育馆呀？ imply?
options: Which gym should we go to?
We shouldn’t go to the gym

exercises.prompt: What does 你开什么玩笑啊？ imply?
What does 你没钱，请我吃什么饭啊？ imply?
options: You shouldn’t treat me when you have no money

exercises.prompt: What does 还看什么电影啊？要考试了 imply?
options: Don’t watch a movie; there is an exam coming

exercises.prompt: What does 还有什么自由呢？ imply?
Between whom is this usage typical?
options: Friends or people who know each other well

exercises.prompt: 还看什么电影啊？要考试了，得复习功___。

lessons.title: 351. Lesson 14 Presentation 2 grammar: the exclamatory sentence with 多
lessons.subtitle: 多自由呀！ · 今天的天气多美啊！ · 我多想旅行全世界啊

explanations.title: Exclamatory Sentence with 多
explanations.body: In Chinese, the exclamatory pattern 多/多么…啊/呀！ may be used to express a strong emotional response to a situation or experience. In this pattern, an adjective describing the speaker’s strong feeling or a verb expressing a strong emotion is placed after 多/多么. Adjective: (Something) + 多/多么 + adjective + 啊/呀！ Verb: Subject + 多/多么 + Verb + Object + 啊/呀！ The book’s examples 1 to 7 follow the sentence from the dialog.

examples.text: 自己去，你可以选自己喜欢的路线，还可以住民宿，和当地人聊天，多自由呀！
examples.translation: zì jǐ qù nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zì jǐ xǐ huān de lù xiàn hái kě yǐ zhù mín sù hé dāng dì rén liáo tiān duō zì yóu ya — Go on your own: you can choose the route you like, stay in a home stay and chat with locals; how free that is!

examples.text: 今天的天气多美啊！
examples.translation: jīn tiān de tiān qì duō měi a — How beautiful the weather is today!

examples.text: 姐姐新买的衣服多么漂亮啊！
examples.translation: jiě jiě xīn mǎi de yī fú duō me piào liàng a — How pretty the clothes my sister just bought are!

examples.text: 做饭日那天，大家多么高兴啊！
examples.translation: zuò fàn rì nà tiān dà jiā duō me gāo xìng a — How happy everyone was on cooking day!

examples.text: 那位老大爷七十多岁了，身体多好呀！
examples.translation: nà wèi lǎo dà yé qī shí duō suì le shēn tǐ duō hǎo ya — That old gentleman is over seventy; how good his health is!

examples.text: 我多么喜欢学习中文啊！
examples.translation: wǒ duō me xǐ huān xué xí zhōng wén a — How much I like studying Chinese!

examples.text: 先生告诉太太说，“我多爱你啊！”
examples.translation: xiān shēng gào sù tài tài shuō wǒ duō ài nǐ a — The husband told his wife, “How much I love you!”

examples.text: 我多想旅行全世界，到每个国家看看啊。
examples.translation: wǒ duō xiǎng lǚ xíng quán shì jiè dào měi gè guó jiā kàn kàn a — How I’d love to travel the whole world and visit every country!

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Work in groups of three. Each group member picks one index card (A: 新鲜, 安全, 努力, 忙, 热. B: 舒服, 清淡, 便宜, 堵, 甜. C: 麻烦, 闷热, 可口, 咸, 贵), studies it, and takes turns selecting one word from the card for a group member to make an exclamatory sentence with 多/多么…啊/呀！ Keep going until all the words are used. My sentences for all fifteen words:

examples.text: 这些菜多新鲜啊！
examples.translation: zhè xiē cài duō xīn xiān a — (Card A: 新鲜) How fresh these dishes are!

examples.text: 这个地方多么安全啊！
examples.translation: zhè ge dì fāng duō me ān quán a — (安全) How safe this place is!

examples.text: 他学习多努力啊！
examples.translation: tā xué xí duō nǔ lì a — (努力) How hard he studies!

examples.text: 我今天多忙啊！
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān duō máng a — (忙) How busy I am today!

examples.text: 今天天气多热啊！
examples.translation: jīn tiān tiān qì duō rè a — (热) How hot it is today!

examples.text: 这张沙发多舒服啊！
examples.translation: zhè zhāng shā fā duō shū fú a — (Card B: 舒服) How comfortable this sofa is!

examples.text: 这个汤多清淡啊！
examples.translation: zhè ge tāng duō qīng dàn a — (清淡) How light this soup is!

examples.text: 这里的东西多便宜啊！
examples.translation: zhè lǐ de dōng xī duō pián yi a — (便宜) How cheap things are here!

examples.text: 下班的时候路上多堵啊！
examples.translation: xià bān de shí hòu lù shàng duō dǔ a — (堵) How jammed the road is at rush hour!

examples.text: 这个西瓜多甜啊！
examples.translation: zhè ge xī guā duō tián a — (甜) How sweet this watermelon is!

examples.text: 自己订旅馆多麻烦啊！
examples.translation: zì jǐ dìng lǚ guǎn duō má fán a — (Card C: 麻烦) How troublesome it is to book hotels yourself!

examples.text: 夏天的天气多么闷热啊！
examples.translation: xià tiān de tiān qì duō me mēn rè a — (闷热) How muggy the summer weather is!

examples.text: 这个菜多可口啊！
examples.translation: zhè ge cài duō kě kǒu a — (可口) How tasty this dish is!

examples.text: 这个汤多咸啊！
examples.translation: zhè ge tāng duō xián a — (咸) How salty this soup is!

examples.text: 北京的房子多贵啊！
examples.translation: běi jīng de fáng zi duō guì a — (贵) How expensive houses in Beijing are!

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Divide into pairs. Create exclamatory sentences complimenting your class, your classmates and DLI (the Defense Language Institute), using 多/多么 + adj. + 啊/呀！ or 多/多么 + VO + 啊/呀. A. Each pair chooses a topic and writes several sentences. B. Exchange your work with other pairs and tell them how you feel about your class, classmates and DLI. My samples:

examples.text: 我们的班多么团结啊！
examples.translation: wǒ men de bān duō me tuán jié a — (mine) How united our class is!

examples.text: 我们的同学多么友好啊！
examples.translation: wǒ men de tóng xué duō me yǒu hǎo a — (mine) How friendly our classmates are!

examples.text: 我们的学校多漂亮啊！
examples.translation: wǒ men de xué xiào duō piào liàng a — (mine) How beautiful our school is!

examples.text: 我多喜欢我们的老师啊！
examples.translation: wǒ duō xǐ huān wǒ men de lǎo shī a — (mine) How much I like our teachers!

exercises.prompt: What does the pattern 多/多么…啊 express?
What comes right after 多/多么?
options: An adjective or a verb of strong feeling

exercises.prompt: What does 今天的天气多美啊！ mean?
options: How beautiful the weather is today!

exercises.prompt: What does 那位老大爷七十多岁了，身体多好呀！ mean?
options: That old man is over seventy; how healthy he is!

exercises.prompt: What does 我多想旅行全世界啊 express?
options: How much I want to travel the whole world!

exercises.prompt: What does 先生告诉太太说，“我多爱你啊！” mean?
What can come after the adjective or verb phrase?
姐姐新买的衣服多么漂___啊！

lessons.title: 352. Lesson 14 Presentation 2 grammar: expressing preferences with 还是
lessons.subtitle: 我们还是明天去吧 · 你还是多穿些衣服吧 · 还是别买了

explanations.title: Express Preferences with 还是
explanations.body: In previous lessons, 还是 was used as an alternative question marker indicating a selection between two or more options. When used in a statement, the adverb 还是 may indicate a choice or preference, similar to the English phrase “had better” or “it would be better to”. 还是 usually comes before a verb or subject. 吧 is often placed after this structure as a suggestion. Patterns: Subject + 还是 + Verb + (吧); 还是 + Subject + Verb + (吧).

examples.text: 像我这样的懒人还是参加旅行团比较方便。
examples.translation: xiàng wǒ zhè yàng de lǎn rén hái shì cān jiā lǚ xíng tuán bǐ jiào fāng biàn — For a lazy person like me, it is better to join a tour group; it would be more convenient.

examples.text: 我们还是明天去吧。
examples.translation: wǒ men hái shì míng tiān qù ba — We’d better go tomorrow.

examples.text: 太晚了，我们还是打车吧。
examples.translation: tài wǎn le wǒ men hái shì dǎ chē ba — It’s too late; we’d better take a taxi.

examples.text: 她不想说，还是不要问了。
examples.translation: tā bù xiǎng shuō hái shì bú yào wèn le — She doesn’t want to talk; better not ask.

examples.text: 今天太冷，你还是多穿些衣服吧。
examples.translation: jīn tiān tài lěng nǐ hái shì duō chuān xiē yī fú ba — It’s too cold today; you’d better put on more clothes.

examples.text: 还是你来我家吧。我七点钟在家等你。
examples.translation: hái shì nǐ lái wǒ jiā ba wǒ qī diǎn zhōng zài jiā děng nǐ — You’d better come to my home. I’ll wait for you at home at seven.

examples.text: 这双皮鞋太贵了，还是别买了。
examples.translation: zhè shuāng pí xié tài guì le hái shì bié mǎi le — These shoes are too expensive; better not buy them.

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8
explanations.body: Activity 7 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to the three dialogs and write notes in the table (speaker’s preference and reason). B. Exchange findings with your partner and share them with the class. (Audio, not included.) Activity 8 帮帮我 (Writing, Speaking and Listening). You will try to help resolve each other’s problems and concerns by offering suggestions using 还是. A. Pair up. In Chinese, write down problems or concerns from your life (four lines). B. In groups of three, take turns reading your problems aloud; the other students offer suggestions using 还是. C. Share some of your group’s problems with the other groups and try to provide more suggestions. A sample exchange (mine):

examples.text: 同学：我今年的作业太多了，睡得很少。
examples.translation: tóng xué wǒ jīn nián de zuò yè tài duō le shuì de hěn shǎo — I have so much homework this year, and I sleep very little.

lessons.title: 353. Lesson 14 Presentation 2: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 周文和高军的旅行计划 · 跟团游 · 黄山 · 景色

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Listen to the dialog once and list all the places described; discuss the topic of the conversation (photo: DLIFLC). B. Listen again and complete the table (Name of Traveler; Travel Activities; Transportation; Accommodations; Other Information). C. With your partner, arrange the sequence of events according to each speaker’s travel plans by numbering the sentences (below, as printed in the book). D. Take turns retelling each speaker’s plan in your own words, using the structure 先… 然后… 最后… E. Read the script and decide which traveler’s plan you like more, then explain why. (Audio, not included, so no sequence key.)

examples.text: 周文的旅行计划：参观西安的名胜古迹。去上海逛逛商场、买买东西。去哈尔滨玩儿几天，在哈尔滨滑雪。
examples.translation: zhōu wén de lǚ xíng jì huà cān guān xī ān de míng shèng gǔ jì qù shàng hǎi guàng guàng shāng chǎng mǎi mǎi dōng xī qù hā ěr bīn wánr jǐ tiān zài hā ěr bīn huá xuě — (the book’s sentences, to be numbered)

examples.text: 高军的旅行计划：和女朋友去广州过春节。和女朋友在北京城里、城外逛逛。去海南岛玩儿一个星期。
examples.translation: gāo jūn de lǚ xíng jì huà hé nǚ péng yǒu qù guǎng zhōu guò chūn jié hé nǚ péng yǒu zài běi jīng chéng lǐ chéng wài guàng guàng qù hǎi nán dǎo wánr yí gè xīng qī — (the book’s sentences, to be numbered)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the conversation between two friends and answer: 1. What did the speakers talk about? 2. What did the two speakers agree to do together? Why? 3. How long will it take to get to the speakers’ hometown from where they are now? 4. What is the second speaker’s warning and suggestion to the first speaker? B. Listen again and complete the table (Information: First Speaker, Second Speaker; rows: 目的地, 为什么去那儿, 旅行方式, 为什么这样旅行). C. Pair up and share your answers. D. Read the script with the class. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): Brochure 1
explanations.body: A. The following travel brochures are from two travel agencies. Work in pairs; each student reads one brochure and writes notes in the table (旅行社; 旅游团: 名字, 目的地; 时间: 天数; 行程: 活动; 费用; 预订). Focus on the tasks and guess the meanings of new words. The book prints numbers as digits and a telephone number; they are spelled out here. The book also shows photographs of Suzhou, Wuzhen and Hangzhou.

examples.text: 苏州加乌镇加杭州，四日三晚，跟团游。苏州，乌镇，杭州。行程特色：一，古镇风光，小桥流水。二，最短时间，美景看全。三，入住商务酒店和民宿。四，游览西湖，尝龙井茶。行程概要。第一天：早晨六点半坐旅游车前往苏州，跟随导游参观苏州市中心和当地有名的园林。晚上看夜景，逛夜市。第二天：坐高铁前往乌镇。坐游船看古镇，和当地人聊天。晚上住民宿。第三天：坐高铁前往杭州，然后坐旅游车跟随导游游览西湖，乘船游西湖，拍照。下午去品尝最有名的龙井茶，购买龙井茶。晚上，在市中心的中国饭馆吃当地特色的饭菜。入住四星商务酒店。第四天：上午自由活动，游市中心，逛街，购物。中午乘高铁离开。费用：每人九百九十九元，包三晚酒店住宿；专用旅游车；中文导游服务；和景点门票。预订：网上预订或打电话，四零零，八一零，五五二二。中国青年旅行社。
examples.translation: sū zhōu jiā wū zhèn jiā háng zhōu sì rì sān wǎn gēn tuán yóu sū zhōu wū zhèn háng zhōu xíng chéng tè sè yì gǔ zhèn fēng guāng xiǎo qiáo liú shuǐ èr zuì duǎn shí jiān měi jǐng kàn quán sān rù zhù shāng wù jiǔ diàn hé mín sù sì yóu lǎn xī hú cháng lóng jǐng chá xíng chéng gài yào dì yī tiān zǎo chén liù diǎn bàn zuò lǚ yóu chē qián wǎng sū zhōu gēn suí dǎo yóu cān guān sū zhōu shì zhōng xīn hé dāng dì yǒu míng de yuán lín wǎn shàng kàn yè jǐng guàng yè shì dì èr tiān zuò gāo tiě qián wǎng wū zhèn zuò yóu chuán kàn gǔ zhèn hé dāng dì rén liáo tiān wǎn shàng zhù mín sù dì sān tiān zuò gāo tiě qián wǎng háng zhōu rán hòu zuò lǚ yóu chē gēn suí dǎo yóu yóu lǎn xī hú chéng chuán yóu xī hú pāi zhào xià wǔ qù pǐn cháng zuì yǒu míng de lóng jǐng chá gòu mǎi lóng jǐng chá wǎn shàng zài shì zhōng xīn de zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī dāng dì tè sè de fàn cài rù zhù sì xīng shāng wù jiǔ diàn dì sì tiān shàng wǔ zì yóu huó dòng yóu shì zhōng xīn guàng jiē gòu wù zhōng wǔ chéng gāo tiě lí kāi fèi yòng měi rén jiǔ bǎi jiǔ shí jiǔ yuán bāo sān wǎn jiǔ diàn zhù sù zhuān yòng lǚ yóu chē zhōng wén dǎo yóu fú wù hé jǐng diǎn mén piào yù dìng wǎng shàng yù dìng huò dǎ diàn huà sì líng líng bā yī líng wǔ wǔ èr èr zhōng guó qīng nián lǚ xíng shè — Suzhou + Wuzhen + Hangzhou, 4 days 3 nights, group tour. Itinerary features: 1. Ancient-town scenery, small bridges and flowing water. 2. The shortest time to see all the beautiful sights. 3. Stay in business hotels and home stays. 4. Tour West Lake and taste Longjing tea. Outline. Day 1: at 6:30 a.m. take the tour bus to Suzhou; follow the guide to visit downtown Suzhou and the famous local gardens. In the evening see the night view and stroll the night market. Day 2: take the high-speed train to Wuzhen. Take a boat to see the ancient town and chat with locals. Stay in a home stay at night. Day 3: take the high-speed train to Hangzhou, then the tour bus with the guide to tour West Lake, boat on West Lake, take photos. In the afternoon go taste the most famous Longjing tea and buy some. In the evening eat local-specialty dishes at a Chinese restaurant downtown. Stay at a four-star business hotel. Day 4: free activities in the morning, tour downtown, stroll and shop. Leave by high-speed train at noon. Cost: 999 yuan per person, including 3 nights’ hotel, a dedicated tour bus, Chinese-language guide service and admission tickets. Booking: online or by phone 400-810-5522 (the phone number is read out digit by digit). China Youth Travel Service.

explanations.title: Brochure 2
explanations.body: Photographs of Suzhou and Hangzhou (not included). The book’s Brochure 2:

examples.text: 黄山风景区，三日两晚，跟团游。行程特色：一，登黄山，看日出。二，观云海，赏美景。三，住五星酒店。四，经典路线，千人出游。行程概要。第一天：从上海出发，坐高铁前往黄山景区。跟随导游坐缆车，游黄山，入住黄山大酒店。晚上看夜景，听松涛声。第二天：早五点半起床，准备看有名的黄山日出。看日出、观云海，拍照。中午起，可以步行下山。不想爬山的游客，可以坐缆车或旅游车去不同的景点。晚上住山下酒店，品安徽名菜。第三天：坐旅游车前往附近的小镇宏村，游老街，在村里散步。到处是景，像画一样，看当地人的生活和房子，买特色产品。费用：每人一千零九十九元，包两晚酒店住宿；两顿早餐，中西餐；专用旅游车；和中英文导游服务；不包景点门票。预订：网上预订或打电话预订，为了您的安全，十八岁以下，六十岁以上游客不可以参加本旅游团。中国天下旅行社。

Itinerary features: 1. Climb Huangshan and watch the sunrise. 2. See the sea of clouds and enjoy beautiful views. 3. Stay in a five-star hotel. 4. A classic route, a thousand people travel it. Outline. Day 1: depart from Shanghai by high-speed train to the Huangshan scenic area. Follow the guide by cable car, tour Huangshan, check in at Huangshan Grand Hotel. In the evening see the night view and listen to the sound of the pines. Day 2: get up at 5:30 to see the famous Huangshan sunrise. Watch the sunrise and sea of clouds, take photos. From noon you can walk down the mountain. Visitors who don’t want to climb can take the cable car or tour bus to different sights. At night stay at the hotel at the foot of the mountain and taste famous Anhui dishes. Day 3: take the tour bus to the nearby small town Hongcun, tour the old street and stroll in the village. Everywhere is scenery, like a painting; see the locals’ life and houses and buy specialty products. Cost: 1099 yuan per person, including 2 nights’ hotel, 2 breakfasts (Chinese and Western), a dedicated tour bus and Chinese–English guide service; scenic-spot tickets not included. Booking: online or by phone; for your safety, visitors under 18 or over 60 cannot join this tour. China Tianxia Travel Service.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking, Writing and Listening): Summer Vacation Travel Plans
explanations.body: Scenario: you are studying Chinese at Shanghai Fudan University in China. Your summer vacation starts in two weeks and you plan to travel around China with some friends (photographs: the Sichuan giant panda reserve, Guilin, Tibet). Decide on travel plans with your friends and figure out all the details. A. Pair up. Research Chinese travel websites to decide where you would like to go (the book lists three travel websites, not included here). 我们打算去：___。 B. After you decide on your destination, write your plans in Chinese characters in the table 暑假旅行计划 (rows: 时间, 目的地, 交通, 活动, 住宿, 旅行方式, 费用, 订票). C. Post your travel plans online and share them with your classmates, who will comment or ask questions.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, Writing and Listening): Travel flyer 美国欢迎你
explanations.body: A U.S. travel agency needs your help creating new printed programs for Chinese tourists (photographs: San Francisco’s Golden Gate Bridge, New York). You and your classmates compete to create travel flyers for popular destinations for Chinese tourists in the U.S.; the flyers must be in Chinese and the winner will be hired as a consultant. A. Pair up and choose a destination: 美国东部, 美国西部, 美国南部, 美国中西部; research relevant travel information. B. Collect for your flyer: region and weather, tourist spots, best times to visit, activity options, transportation options, accommodation options, take a tour or travel independently, estimated costs, how to book the travel program. C. Design your flyer on a white board or flip chart and post it. D. Each pair presents its flyer to the agency’s marketing team (the class) and explains why its program is the best choice. E. The winner is announced after a vote.

rows: Take a tour or travel independently
How to book the travel program

Divide the class into two groups; Group A advocates traveling with a tour and Group B independent travel. B. In your group, prepare for the debate: discuss the advantages of your mode of travel and create in Chinese a list of the benefits (跟团游的好处 / 自由行的好处, four lines), with supporting examples (stories, statistics, etc.). C. Discuss and list the disadvantages of the other group’s mode of travel (的坏处, four lines). D. Your teacher facilitates the debate. (Photographs not included.)

lessons.title: 356. Lesson 14 Presentation 3: my parents visit Monterey
lessons.subtitle: 爸爸妈妈终于有时间来看我了 · 渔人码头 · 金门大桥

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Photographs: Fisherman’s Wharf, a whale, jellyfish in an aquarium, the Golden Gate Bridge (not included). Pair up and answer: A. Think about a trip you have gone on with your family or friends. Where did you go? When was the trip? What did you do? Share your stories. B. Now that you have been in Monterey for a while, which tourist spots have you seen and what did you do? C. Have you been to San Francisco? If so, tell the class what you did there. D. What are your favorite things to do when you travel?

explanations.title: Presentation 3
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters. Notes: 1. 一直: the structure “verb + 一直 + 到 + time/event” emphasizes an ongoing duration; 到 means “until”. 2. In this presentation both 又 and 再 mean “additionally/also”; 又 indicates an action that has already taken place, while 再 indicates an action that has yet to take place.

examples.text: 我在蒙特雷已经住了三年了。今年八月，爸爸妈妈都退休了，终于有时间来看我了。他们的飞机是下午四点到机场的。我开车把他们接到我住的公寓。这是他们第一次来蒙特雷，显得特别兴奋，我们一直聊到很晚。第二天我带他们去参观蒙特雷附近的景点。我们先去了水族馆。这个水族馆不算大，可是有各种各样的海洋动物。从水族馆出来，我们又去了渔人码头。码头两边都是商店和饭店。我们选了一家海鲜饭店，那家饭店的海鲜很有名，而且可以从饭店看到海景。吃完饭以后，我们又沿着海边散了半个小时的步。下个周末，我打算带爸爸妈妈去看看旧金山的金门大桥，然后再去中国城吃广式早茶。

This August my parents both retired and finally have time to come see me. Their plane arrived at the airport at four in the afternoon. I drove and picked them up to my apartment. It was their first time coming to Monterey and they seemed especially excited; we chatted until very late. The next day I took them to visit the sights near Monterey. We first went to the aquarium. This aquarium isn’t big, but it has all kinds of marine animals. After coming out of the aquarium, we went again to Fisherman’s Wharf. Both sides of the wharf are shops and restaurants. We chose a seafood restaurant; that restaurant’s seafood is famous, and you can see the sea view from the restaurant. After the meal we walked another half hour along the seashore. Next weekend I plan to take my parents to see San Francisco’s Golden Gate Bridge, and then go to Chinatown for Cantonese-style morning tea.

lessons.title: 358. Lesson 14 Presentation 3 grammar: the time-measure complement 时量补语
lessons.subtitle: 我在蒙特雷已经住了三年了 · 他学中文学了三年了 · 锻炼了一个小时的身体

explanations.title: The Time-Measure Complement 时量补语
explanations.body: In Chinese, a time-measure complement expresses the duration of an action (time spent). Structurally, a time-measure complement is placed after a verb’s predicate. When the verb takes both an object and a time-measure complement, the verb is usually repeated in the sentence between the object and the time-measure complement. A variation: place the time and the object together and add 的 between them, making the time a modifier of the object. Without object: S + V + Time-Measure Complement (general action); S + V + 了 + Time-Measure Complement (past action); S + V + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + 了 (continuing action). With object: S + V + O + V + Time-Measure Complement (general); S + V + O + V + 了 + Time-Measure Complement (past); S + V + O + V + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + 了 (continuing). Variation: S + V + Time-Measure Complement + 的 + O (general); S + V + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + 的 + O (past); S + V + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + 的 + O + 了 (continuing).

lessons.title: 359. Lesson 14 Presentation 3 grammar: the double 了 structure
lessons.subtitle: 我在蒙特雷住了三个月了 · 学中文学了多久了？ · 跑了半个小时的步了

explanations.title: Double 了 Structure (indicating an ongoing situation)
explanations.body: In Chinese, the double 了 structure (with both the verb 了 and the sentence 了) indicates an ongoing situation when a sentence contains a time-measure complement. This is similar to the English “…have been doing something for a period of time”. In the first example the first 了 is placed after the verb, followed by a time-measure complement (duration), and the second 了 is placed at the end of the sentence. The verbs used in this structure must be continuative verbs or verb phrases, such as 住, 上课, 学习, 游泳, 打电话, 看电视. Patterns: Sub. + Verb + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + 了; Sub. + Verb + Object + Verb + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + 了; Subject + Verb + 了 + Time-Measure Complement + Object + 了.

examples.text: 我在蒙特雷住了三个月了。

explanations.body: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening). Pair up. A. Ask your partner if they do the activities every day (锻炼, 上课, 睡觉, 做作业, 看电视) and, if so, for how long. B. Activity 5 (Listening and Speaking). Listen to the dialog and answer: 1. What has the second speaker been doing and for how long? 2. What are the first speaker’s hobbies?
